1	---
2	name: Rust Rewrite Decision
3	description: Decision to rewrite clui from Ink/React to Rust/Ratatui — context and rationale
4	type: project
5	---
6	
7	## Decision
8	Rewrite clui TUI from TypeScript/Ink/React to Rust/Ratatui. Keep existing TS version as prototype reference.
9	
10	## Why
11	- Ink has no per-widget click handlers — all mouse positioning is manual coordinate math, constantly broken
12	- yoga WASM crashes on position="absolute" (ConfirmDialog)
13	- useInput is global — every component receives every keypress, causing conflicts
14	- Mouse event interception requires hacky stdin.emit patching / Transform streams
15	- Performance: Ink re-renders entire screen on any state change
16	
17	## What Ratatui gives us
18	- Native mouse support with per-widget click areas (crossterm events)
19	- No WASM, no yoga — pure Rust layout
20	- Focus/input routing built into the framework
21	- Single binary, instant startup
22	- 10x faster rendering
23	
24	## Scope
25	~20-25 hours with Claude Code. Port all features from docs/FEATURES.md.
26	
27	## Architecture for Rust version
28	- ratatui + crossterm for TUI
29	- tokio for async (IPC, file watching, git)
30	- serde for JSONL parsing (sessions)
31	- git2 (libgit2) for git operations
32	- syntect for syntax highlighting
33	- Keep IPC protocol compatible with existing TS workers (or rewrite workers too)
34	
35	**How to apply:** Start fresh in the same repo. Reference docs/FEATURES.md and screenshots for feature parity. Port incrementally — layout first, then panels, then mouse, then viewers.
36

1	import net from "node:net";
2	import path from "node:path";
3	import { config } from "./config.js";
4	import type { Pin, StatusBarData, CompactEvent } from "./types.js";
5	
6	// Shell -> Worker
7	export type ShellToWorkerMessage =
8	  | { type: "send_prompt"; prompt: string; pins: Pin[] }
9	  | { type: "context_reset" }
10	  | { type: "context_snapshot" }
11	  | { type: "get_context_summary" }
12	  | { type: "set_worktree"; worktreePath: string | null; branch: string | null }
13	  | { type: "shutdown" };
14	
15	// Worker -> Shell
16	export type WorkerToShellMessage =
17	  | { type: "ready"; workerId: string }
18	  | { type: "stream_chunk"; content: string }
19	  | { type: "message_complete"; role: string; content: string; tokens: number; cost: number }
20	  | { type: "context_compacted"; event: CompactEvent }
21	  | { type: "context_summary"; summary: string }
22	  | { type: "status_update"; data: Partial<StatusBarData> }
23	  | { type: "error"; message: string; fatal: boolean }
24	  | { type: "snapshot_complete"; filePath: string; summary: string };
25	
26	export type IPCMessage = ShellToWorkerMessage | WorkerToShellMessage;
27	
28	const HEADER_SIZE = 4;
29	
30	export function encodeMessage(msg: IPCMessage): Buffer {
31	  const json = JSON.stringify(msg);
32	  const payload = Buffer.from(json, "utf-8");
33	  const header = Buffer.alloc(HEADER_SIZE);
34	  header.writeUInt32BE(payload.length, 0);
35	  return Buffer.concat([header, payload]);
36	}
37	
38	export class MessageDecoder {
39	  private buffer = Buffer.alloc(0);
40	
41	  feed(data: Buffer): IPCMessage[] {
42	    this.buffer = Buffer.concat([this.buffer, data]);
43	    const messages: IPCMessage[] = [];
44	
45	    while (this.buffer.length >= HEADER_SIZE) {
46	      const length = this.buffer.readUInt32BE(0);
47	      if (this.buffer.length < HEADER_SIZE + length) break;
48	
49	      const json = this.buffer.subarray(HEADER_SIZE, HEADER_SIZE + length).toString("utf-8");
50	      this.buffer = this.buffer.subarray(HEADER_SIZE + length);
51	
52	      try {
53	        messages.push(JSON.parse(json));
54	      } catch {
55	        // Skip malformed messages
56	      }
57	    }
58	
59	    return messages;
60	  }
61	}
62	
63	export function socketPath(workerId: string): string {
64	  return path.join(config.socketDir, `worker-${workerId}.sock`);
65	}
66	
67	export function sendMessage(socket: net.Socket, msg: IPCMessage): void {
68	  socket.write(encodeMessage(msg));
69	}
70	
71	export function createIPCServer(
72	  sockPath: string,
73	  onMessage: (msg: IPCMessage, socket: net.Socket) => void
74	): net.Server {
75	  const server = net.createServer((socket) => {
76	    const decoder = new MessageDecoder();
77	    socket.on("data", (data: Buffer) => {
78	      for (const msg of decoder.feed(data)) {
79	        onMessage(msg, socket);
80	      }
81	    });
82	  });
83	
84	  server.listen(sockPath);
85	  return server;
86	}
87	
88	export function connectIPC(
89	  sockPath: string,
90	  onMessage: (msg: IPCMessage) => void
91	): Promise<net.Socket> {
92	  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
93	    const socket = net.createConnection(sockPath, () => {
94	      const decoder = new MessageDecoder();
95	      socket.on("data", (data: Buffer) => {
96	        for (const msg of decoder.feed(data)) {
97	          onMessage(msg);
98	        }
99	      });
100	      resolve(socket);
101	    });
102	    socket.on("error", reject);
103	  });
104	}
105

One more:

The TS version uses separate worker **processes** (one per tab) connected via Unix sockets. In Rust with tokio, the natural approach is **single process + async tasks** — each "worker" is a tokio task, no IPC needed, shared state via channels/Arc/Mutex.

Keep multi-process isolation (one Rust binary forked per tab) or **single process + tokio tasks**?

> DEVELOPER

which is bettter?

> AGENT

Single process + tokio tasks. Reasons:

- No IPC serialization overhead — workers share state via `Arc<Mutex<>>`/channels directly
- Tokio tasks are ~KB each vs MB per process
- Rust memory safety eliminates the main reason for process isolation (no WASM crashes, no unhandled rejections killing a process)
- Dramatically less code — no socket management, no framing protocol, no worker lifecycle IPC
- More idiomatic Rust

The TS version needed process isolation because Node workers could crash from yoga WASM, unhandled promises, etc. Rust doesn't have those failure modes.

Going with single process + tokio tasks.

**3 approaches for the overall rewrite strategy:**

---

**A) Big bang** — implement everything at once, run only when complete.
- Risk: 2-3k lines before you see anything. Hard to debug. Not recommended.

**B) Incremental layers** *(recommended)* — layout shell → input → chat streaming → sidebars → git/files/skills → viewers
- Each layer is runnable. Visible progress. Bugs caught early.
- ~8-10 milestones, each shippable.

**C) Feature-by-feature** — complete one feature fully (including edge cases) before touching the next.
- Fine for isolated features but bad for layout-dependent components (everything depends on the layout working first).

**Recommendation: B.** Lay the bones first (terminal loop, layout, input), then flesh out each panel, then advanced viewers. Each milestone produces a working binary.

Agreed?

**Design — Section 1: Crate structure**

```
clui/
├── prototype/          # existing TS code (moved)
├── rust/               # new Cargo workspace
│   ├── Cargo.toml      # workspace root
│   ├── crates/
│   │   ├── app/        # main binary — TUI loop, event routing
│   │   ├── ui/         # all ratatui widgets (layout, panels, input, viewers)
│   │   ├── agent/      # Anthropic API client — streaming, session management
│   │   ├── git/        # git operations (git2)
│   │   ├── skills/     # skill discovery (3-tier cascade)
│   │   ├── db/         # SQLite persistence (rusqlite)
│   │   └── config/     # paths, settings
│   └── ...
```

Each crate has one responsibility. `app` wires them together. `ui` knows nothing about `agent` — it only renders state passed to it. `agent` knows nothing about `ui` — it sends events over channels.

Does this structure look right?

> DEVELOPER

ok ok

> AGENT

**Design — Section 2: State & event flow**

Single `AppState` struct owned by the main loop. Workers are tokio tasks, each with a channel pair:

```
Main loop (60fps ratatui render)
    │
    ├── crossterm events → EventRouter → mutates AppState
    │
    ├── AgentTask (per tab, tokio::spawn)
    │     └── Anthropic SSE stream → tx channel → AppState.tabs[n].messages
    │
    ├── GitWatcher (tokio interval, 5s) → AppState.git
    │
    └── FileWatcher (notify crate) → AppState.files
```

`AppState` is `Arc<Mutex<AppState>>` — main loop holds the lock to render, releases it between frames so agent tasks can push stream chunks.

Key state slices:
- `tabs: Vec<TabState>` — each has messages, input, scroll, status bar data
- `git: GitState` — branch, staged/unstaged files
- `files: FileTreeState` — expanded dirs, selection, pins
- `skills: SkillsState` — 3-tier discovered skills
- `layout: LayoutState` — sidebar widths, active panels, focus

  "content": "# clui Rust Rewrite — Design Spec\n\n**Date:** 2026-04-07  \n**Status:** Approved\n\n---\n\n## Overview\n\nFull rewrite of clui TUI from TypeScript/Ink/React to Rust/Ratatui. New code lives in `rust/` as a Cargo workspace.\n\n---\n\n## Motivation\n\n- Ink has no per-widget click areas — mouse positioning is manual coordinate math, constantly broken\n- yoga WASM crashes on `position=\"absolute\"` (ConfirmDialog)\n- `useInput` is global — every component receives every keypress\n- Mouse interception requires hacky stdin Transform streams\n- Ink re-renders the entire screen on any state change\n\nRatatui gives us: native crossterm mouse events with exact cell coordinates, no WASM, no React, focus routing built-in, single binary, 10x faster rendering.\n\n---\n\n## Repo Layout\n\n```\nclui/\n├── prototype/          # existing TS code (moved from root)\n├── rust/               # new Cargo workspace\n│   ├── Cargo.toml\n│   └── crates/\n│       ├── app/        # binary — main loop, event routing, state wiring\n│       ├── ui/         # all ratatui widgets (stateless renderers)\n│       ├── agent/      # Anthropic API client — streaming SSE, session mgmt\n│       ├── git/        # git operations via git2\n│       ├── skills/     # 3-tier skill discovery (repo > user > global)\n│       ├── db/         # SQLite persistence via rusqlite\n│       └── config/     # paths, settings, constants\n└── docs/\n```\n\n---\n\n## Architecture\n\n### Process Model\n\nSingle Rust process. Each tab's agent runs as a `tokio::spawn` task communicating with the main loop via `mpsc` channels.\n\n```\nMain loop (ratatui render + crossterm event poll)\n    │\n    ├── crossterm Event → EventRouter → mutates AppState\n    │\n    ├── AgentTask[0..n] (tokio task per tab)\n    │     └── Anthropic SSE stream → tx → AppState.tabs[n].messages\n    │\n    ├── GitWatcher (tokio interval 5s) → AppState.git\n    │\n    └── FileWatcher (notify) → AppState.files\n```\n\n### State\n\n`AppState` is `Arc<Mutex<AppState>>` shared between the main loop and background tasks.\n\n```rust\nstruct AppState {\n    tabs: Vec<TabState>,\n    active_tab: usize,\n    git: GitState,\n    files: FileTreeState,\n    skills: SkillsState,\n    layout: LayoutState,\n    notifications: Vec<Notification>,\n    confirm_dialog: Option<ConfirmDialog>,\n}\n\nstruct TabState {\n    id: String,\n    name: String,\n    kind: TabKind,           // Chat | FileViewer | DiffViewer\n    messages: Vec<Message>,\n    input: InputState,\n    scroll: usize,\n    status: StatusBarData,\n    pins: Vec<Pin>,\n    agent_tx: Option<mpsc::Sender<AgentCommand>>,\n}\n\nstruct LayoutState {\n    left_sidebar_width: u16,\n    right_sidebar_width: u16,\n    left_panel: LeftPanel,   // Sessions | Git | Files\n    right_panel: RightPanel, // Skills | MCPs\n    left_visible: bool,\n    right_visible: bool,\n    focus: Focus,\n}\n```\n\n### Rendering\n\n`ui/` crate contains pure functions: `fn render_layout(f: &mut Frame, state: &AppState)`. No state mutation in render. All widgets receive immutable state slices.\n\n---\n\n## Key Crates\n\n| Purpose | Crate |\n|---|---|\n| TUI | `ratatui` + `crossterm` |\n| Async runtime | `tokio` (full features) |\n| HTTP + SSE streaming | `reqwest` (stream feature) |\n| Git operations | `git2` |\n| SQLite | `rusqlite` (bundled) |\n| Syntax highlighting | `syntect` |\n| JSON | `serde` + `serde_json` |\n| File watching | `notify` |\n| Config paths | `dirs` |\n| Error handling | `anyhow` |\n| Async utils | `tokio-stream`, `futures` |\n\n---\n\n## Agent / Anthropic API\n\nWorkers call the Anthropic Messages API directly via `reqwest` with SSE streaming. No SDK dependency. Each tab's agent task:\n\n1. Receives `AgentCommand::SendPrompt { text, pins }` from main loop\n2. Builds the messages array (conversation history + pinned context)\n3. POSTs to `https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages` with `stream: true`\n4. Parses SSE events, sends `AgentEvent::StreamChunk { content }` back to main loop\n5. On `message_stop`, sends `AgentEvent::MessageComplete { tokens, cost }`\n\nAPI key from `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` env var (same as TS version).\n\n---\n\n## Mouse Support\n\ncrossterm's `EnableMouseCapture` gives us `MouseEvent { kind, column, row, modifiers }` with exact cell coordinates. Each widget knows its `Rect` (area). Hit testing: `rect.contains(Position { x: col, y: row })`.\n\nResizable sidebars: track drag state in `LayoutState`. On `MouseEventKind::Down` on a border column, set `dragging = true`. On `MouseEventKind::Moved`, update sidebar width. On `Up`, clear drag state.\n\n---\n\n## Input Bar\n\nCustom multiline editor in `ui/input.rs`. State:\n\n```rust\nstruct InputState {\n    lines: Vec<String>,\n    cursor: (usize, usize),       // (line, col)\n    selection: Option<Selection>,\n    scroll_offset: usize,\n}\n```\n\nAll terminal key sequences handled via crossterm `KeyEvent`. Selection rendered as reversed style spans.\n\n---\n\n## File Layout (rust/ crate internals)\n\n```\ncrates/app/src/\n    main.rs          # terminal setup, main loop\n    event.rs         # crossterm event → AppEvent enum\n    router.rs        # eventsource_stream::Eventsource;\nuse futures::StreamExt;\nuse reqwest::Client;\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse tokio::sync::mpsc;\n\nuse crate::stream::{parse_sse_data, SseEvent};\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct AgentConfig {\n    pub api_key: String,\n    pub model: String,\n    pub max_tokens: u32,\n    pub cwd: String,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ApiMessage {\n    pub role: String,\n    pub content: String,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum AgentEvent {\n    StreamChunk(String),\n    MessageComplete { content: String, output_tokens: u32 },\n    Error(String),\n}\n\npub struct AgentClient {\n    config: AgentConfig,\n    http: Client,\n    history: Vec<ApiMessage>,\n}\n\nimpl AgentClient {\n    pub fn new(config: AgentConfig) -> Self {\n        Self {\n            config,\n            http: Client::new(),\n            history: Vec::new(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn reset(&mut self) {\n        self.history.clear();\n    }\n\n    /// Send a prompt and stream events back via `tx`.\n    pub async fn send(&mut self, prompt: String, system: Option<String>,\n                      tx: mpsc::Sender<AgentEvent>) -> Result<()> {\n        self.history.push(ApiMessage { role: \"user\".into(), content: prompt });\n\n        #[derive(Serialize)]\n        struct Body<'a> {\n            model: &'a str,\n            max_tokens: u32,\n            stream: bool,\n            messages: &'a [ApiMessage],\n            #[serde(skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n            system: Option<&'a str>,\n        }\n\n        let body = Body {\n            model: &self.config.model,\n            max_tokens: self.config.max_tokens,\n            stream: true,\n            messages: &self.history,\n            system: system.as_deref(),\n        };\n\n        let response = self.http\n            .post(\"https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages\")\n            .header(\"x-api-key\", &self.config.api_key)\n            .header(\"anthropic-version\", \"2023-06-01\")\n            .header(\"content-type\", \"application/json\")\n            .json(&body)\n            .send()\n            .await\n            .context(\"failed to connect to Anthropic API\")?;\n\n        if !response.status().is_success() {\n            let status = response.status();\n            let body = response.text().await.unwrap_or_default();\n            let _ = tx.send(AgentEvent::Error(format!(\"API error {status}: {body}\"))).await;\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n\n        let mut full_content = String::new();\n        let mut output_tokens = 0u32;\n        let mut stream = response.bytes_stream().eventsource();\n\n        while let Some(event_result) = stream.next().await {\n            match event_result {\n                Ok(event) => {\n                    if event.data == \"[DONE]\" { break; }\n                    match parse_sse_data(&event.data) {\n                        Ok(SseEvent::TextDelta(text)) => {\n                            full_content.push_str(&text);\n                            let _ = tx.send(AgentEvent::StreamChunk(text)).await;\n                        }\n                        Ok(SseEvent::MessageDelta { output_tokens: n }) => {\n                            output_tokens = n;\n                        }\n                        Ok(SseEvent::MessageStop) => break,\n                        _ => {}\n                    }\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    let _ = tx.send(AgentEvent::Error(e.to_string())).await;\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        self.history.push(ApiMessage { role: \"assistant\".into(), content: full_content.clone() });\n        let _ = tx.send(AgentEvent::MessageComplete { content: full_content, output_tokens }).await;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 5: Wire Implement**\n\n```rust\n// rust/crates/git/src/lib.rs\nuse anyhow::{Context, Result};\nuse git2::{Repository, StatusOptions, Delta};\nuse std::path::Path;\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]\npub enum FileStatus { Modified, Added, Deleted, Renamed, Untracked }\n\nimpl FileStatus {\n    pub fn from_delta(delta: Delta) -> Self {\n        match delta {\n            Delta::Added => Self::Added,\n            Delta::Deleted => Self::Deleted,\n            Delta::Renamed => Self::Renamed,\n            _ => Self::Modified,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct DiffEntry {\n    pub path: String,\n    pub status: FileStatus,\n    pub staged: bool,\n}\n\nimpl DiffEntry {\n    pub fn status_char(&self) -> char {\n        match self.status {\n            FileStatus::Modified => 'M',\n            FileStatus::Added => 'A',\n            FileStatus::Deleted => 'D',\n            FileStatus::Renamed => 'R',\n            FileStatus::Untracked => '?',\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]\npub struct GitStatusResult {\n    pub branch: String,\n    pub staged: Vec<DiffEntry>,\n    pub unstaged: Vec<DiffEntry>,\n}\n\npub fn git_status(cwd: &Path) -> Result<GitStatusResult> {\n    let repo = Repository::discover(cwd)\n        .context(\"not a git repository\")?;\n\n    let branch = repo.head()\n        .ok()\n        .and_then(|h| h.shorthand().map(|s| s.to_string()))\n        .unwrap_or_else(|| \"HEAD\".to_string());\n\n    let mut opts = StatusOptions::new();\n    opts.include_untracked(true).recurse_untracked_dirs(true);\n    let statuses = repo.statuses(Some(&mut opts))?;\n\n    let mut staged = Vec::new();\n    let mut unstaged = Vec::new();\n\n    for entry in statuses.iter() {\n        let path = entry.path().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n        let s = entry.status();\n\n        if s.contains(git2::Status::INDEX_MODIFIED) || s.contains(git2::Status::INDEX_NEW) || s.contains(git2::Status::INDEX_DELETED) {\n            let status = if s.contains(git2::Status::INDEX_NEW) { FileStatus::Added }\n                else if s.contains(git2::Status::INDEX_DELETED) { FileStatus::Deleted }\n                else { FileStatus::Modified };\n            staged.push(DiffEntry { path: path.clone(), status, staged: true });\n        }\n\n        if s.contains(git2::Status::WT_MODIFIED) || s.contains(git2::Status::WT_DELETED) {\n            let status = if s.contains(git2::Status::WT_DELETED) { FileStatus::Deleted }\n                else { FileStatus::Modified };\n            unstaged.push(DiffEntry { path: path.clone(), status, staged: false });\n        }\n\n        if s.contains(git2::Status::WT_NEW) {\n            unstaged.push(DiffEntry { path: path.clone(), status: FileStatus::Untracked, staged: false });\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(GitStatusResult { branch, staged, unstaged })\n}\n\npub fn stage_file(cwd: &Path, path: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let repo = Repository::discover(cwd)?;\n    let mut index = repo.index()?;\n    index.add_path(Path::new(path))?;\n    index.write()?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\npub fn unstage_file(cwd: &Path, path: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let repo = Repository::discover(cwd)?;\n    let head = repo.head().ok().and_then(|h| h.peel_to_commit().ok());\n    match head {\n        Some(commit) => {\n            let obj = commit.tree()?.get_path(Path::new(path))?.to_object(&repo)?;\n            repo.reset_default(None, &[Path::new(path)])?;\n        }\n        None => {\n            // no commits yet, just remove from index\n            let mut index = repo.index()?;\n            index.remove_path(Path::new(path))?;\n            index.write()?;\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\npub fn discard_file(cwd: &Path, path: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let repo = Repository::discover(cwd)?;\n    let mut checkout = git2::build::CheckoutBuilder::new();\n    checkout.path(path).force();\n    repo.checkout_head(Some(&mut checkout))?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\npub fn file_diff(cwd: &Path, path: &str, staged: bool) -> Result<String> {\n    let repo = Repository::discover(cwd)?;\n    let mut diff_opts = git2::DiffOptions::new();\n    diff_opts.pathspec(path);\n\n    let diff = if staged {\n        let head_tree = repo.head().ok()\n            .and_then(|h| h.peel_to_commit().ok())\n            .and_then(|c| c.tree().ok());\n        let index = repo.index()?;\n        repo.diff_tree_to_index(head_tree.as_ref(), Some(&index), Some(&mut diff_opts))?\n    } else {\n        repo.diff_index_to_workdir(None, Some(&mut diff_opts))?\n    };\n\n    let mut output = String::new();\n    diff.print(git2::DiffFormat::Patch, |_, _, line| {\n        let content = std::str::from_utf8(line.content()).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        output.push_str(content);\n        true\n    })?;\n    Ok(output)\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 4: Run tests — expect **Step 3: Implement**\n\n```rust\n// rust/crates/skills/src/lib.rs\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Skill {\n    pub name: String,\n    pub path: String,\n    pub overridden: bool,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]\npub struct SkillSet {\n    pub repo: Vec<Skill>,\n    pub user: Vec<Skill>,\n    pub global: Vec<Skill>,\n}\n\npub fn discover_in_dir(dir: &Path) -> Vec<Skill> {\n    let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(dir) else { return Vec::new() };\n    let mut skills: Vec<Skill> = entries\n        .filter_map(|e| e.ok())\n        .filter(|e| e.path().extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some(\"md\"))\n        .map(|e| {\n            let path = e.path();\n            let name = path.file_stem().unwrap_or_default().to_string_lossy().to_string();\n            Skill { name, path: path.to_string_lossy().to_string(), overridden: false }\n        })\n        .collect();\n    skills.sort_by(|a, b| a.name.cmp(&b.name));\n    skills\n}\n\n/// Mark skills in `lower` as overridden if a skill with the same name exists in `higher`.\npub fn apply_override_flags(higher: &[Skill], lower: &[Skill]) -> Vec<Skill> {\n    let higher_names: std::collections::HashSet<&str> =\n        higher.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect();\n    lower.iter().map(|s| Skill {\n        overridden: higher_names.contains(s.name.as_str()),\n        ..s.clone()\n    }).collect()\n}\n\npub fn discover(cwd: &Path, paths: &clui_config::Paths) -> SkillSet {\n    let repo_skills_dir = cwd.join(\".claude\").join(\"skills\");\n    let repo = discover_in_dir(&repo_skills_dir);\n    let user = discover_in_dir(&paths.claude_skills_dir);\n    let global = discover_in_dir(&paths.global_skills_dir);\n\n    let user_with_flags = apply_override_flags(&repo, &user);\n    let global_with_flags = apply_override_flags(&user, &apply_override_flags(&repo, &global));\n\n    SkillSet { repo, user: user_with_flags, global: global_with_flags }\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 4: Run tests — expect pass**\n\n```bash\ncd rust && cargo test -p clui-skills rust/crates/app/src/main.rs\nmod state;\nmod event;\nmod router;\nmod agent_task;\nmod ui;\n\nuse std::io;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse crossterm::{\n    event::{self, Event, EnableMouseCapture, DisableMouseCapture},\n    execute,\n    terminal::{enable_raw_mode, disable_raw_mode, EnterAlternateScreen, LeaveAlternateScreen},\n};\nuse ratatui::{backend::CrosstermBackend, Terminal};\n\nuse event::AppEvent;\nuse state::AppState;\n\n#[tokio::main]\nasync fn main() -> Result<()> {\n    let cwd = std::env::current_dir()?;\n\n    // Terminal setup\n    enable_raw_mode()?;\n    let mut stdout = io::stdout();\n    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, EnableMouseCapture)?;\n    let backend = CrosstermBackend::new(io::stdout());\n    let mut terminal = Terminal::new(backend)?;\n    terminal.clear()?;\n\n    let size = terminal.size()?;\n    let mut app = AppState::new(cwd);\n    app.layout.terminal_cols = size.width;\n    app.layout.terminal_rows = size.height;\n\n    let result = run_loop(&mut terminal, &mut app).await;\n\n    // Cleanup\n    disable_raw_mode()?;\n    execute!(io::stdout(), LeaveAlternateScreen, DisableMouseCapture)?;\n    terminal.show_cursor()?;\n\n    result\n}\n\nasync fn run_loop(\n    terminal: &mut ratatui::Terminal<CrosstermBackend<io::Stdout>>,\n    state: &mut AppState,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    loop {\n        terminal.draw(|f| ui::render(f, state))?;\n\n        // Poll events with 16ms timeout (~60fps)\n        if event::poll(Duration::from_millis(16))? {\n            match event::read()? {\n                Event::Key(key) => {\n                    router::handle(state, AppEvent::Key {\n                        code: key.code,\n                        modifiers: key.modifiers,\n                    });\n                }\n                Event::Mouse(m) => {\n                    router::handle(state, AppEvent::Mouse {\n                        kind: m.kind,\n                        col: m.column,\n                        row: m.row,\n                        modifiers: m.modifiers,\n                    });\n                }\n                Event::Resize(cols, rows) => {\n                    router::handle(state, AppEvent::Resize { cols, rows });\n                }\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        } else {\n            router::handle(state, AppEvent::Tick);\n        }\n\n        if state.should_quit { break; }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 5: Create agent_task stub**\n\n```rust\n//  Frame,\n    layout::{Constraint, Direction, Layout, Rect},\n    style::{Color, Style, Modifier},\n    text::{Line, Span},\n    widgets::{Block, Borders, BorderType, Paragraph, Tabs},\n};\nuse crate::state::{AppState, LayoutState, TabKind};\n\npub struct ColumnAreas {\n    pub tab_bar: Rect,\n    pub left: Rect,\n    pub center: Rect,\n    pub right: Rect,\n}\n\npub fn compute_columns(layout: &LayoutState, area: Rect) -> ColumnAreas {\n    // Top row: tab bar (1 line)\n    let vertical = Layout::vertical([Constraint::Length(3), Constraint::Min(0)]).split(area);\n    let tab_bar = vertical[0];\n    let body = vertical[1];\n\n    let left_w = if layout.left_visible { layout.left_width() } else { 0 };\n    let right_w = if layout.right_visible { layout.right_width() } else { 0 };\n    let center_w = body.width.saturating_sub(left_w + right_w);\n\n    let cols = Layout::horizontal([\n        Constraint::Length(left_w),\n        Constraint::Length(center_w),\n        Constraint::Length(right_w),\n    ]).split(body);\n\n    ColumnAreas { tab_bar, left: cols[0], center: cols[1], right: cols[2] }\n}\n\npub fn render_tab_bar(f: &mut Frame, state: &AppState, area: Rect) {\n    let titles: Vec<Line> = state.tabs.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, tab)| {\n        let style = if i == state.active_tab {\n            Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)\n        } else {\n            Style::default().fg(Color::Gray)\n        };\n        Line::from(Span::styled(format!(\" {} \", tab.name), style))\n    }).collect();\n\n    let tabs = Tabs::new(titles)\n        .block(Block::default().borders(Borders::ALL).border_type(BorderType::Rounded))\n        .select(state.active_tab)\n        .highlight_style(Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD))\n        .divider(\"|\");\n    f.render_widget(tabs, area);\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 4: Wire render state mutations**\n\n```rust\n// rust/crates/app/src/ui/input.rs\nuse crate::state::{InputState, Selection};\n\npub fn input_char(s: &mut InputState, c: char) {\n    s.selection = None;\n    let line = &mut s.lines[s.cursor_line];\n    let byte_idx = char_to_byte_idx(line, s.cursor_col);\n    line.insert(byte_idx, c);\n    s.cursor_col += 1;\n}\n\npub fn input_backspace(s: &mut InputState) {\n    if let Some(sel) = s.selection.take() {\n        delete_selection(s, &sel);\n        return;\n    }\n    if s.cursor_col > 0 {\n        let line = &mut s.lines[s.cursor_line];\n        let byte_idx = char_to_byte_idx(line, s.cursor_col);\n        let prev = prev_char_boundary(line, byte_idx);\n        line.drain(prev..byte_idx);\n        s.cursor_col -= 1;\n    } else if s.cursor_line > 0 {\n s.cursor_col = prev_len;\n    }\n}\n\npub fn input_newline(s: &mut InputState) {\n    s.selection = None;\n    let line = s.lines[s.cursor_line].clone();\n    let byte_idx = char_to_byte_idx(&line, s.cursor_col);\n    let rest = line[byte_idx..].to_string();\n    s.lines[s.cursor_line].truncate(byte_idx);\n    s.cursor_line += 1;\n    s.lines.insert(s.cursor_line, rest);\n    s.cursor_col = 0;\n}\n\npub fn input_delete_word_left(s: &mut InputState) {\n    let line = &s.lines[s.cursor_line];\n    let col = s.cursor_col;\n    if col == 0 { return input_backspace(s); }\n    // find start of previous word\n    let chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();\n    let mut i = col;\n    while i > 0 && chars[i-1] == ' ' { i -= 1; }\n    while i > 0 && chars[i-1] != ' ' { i -= 1; }\n    let remove_count = col - i;\n    for _ in 0..remove_count { \n        s.cursor_col = col - (col - i);\n        let line = &mut s.lines[s.cursor_line];\n        let byte_start = char_to_byte_idx(line, i);\n        let byte_end = char_to_byte_idx(line, col);\n        line.drain(byte_start..byte_end);\n        s.cursor_col = i;\n        return;\n    }\n}\n\npub fn input_delete_line(s: &mut InputState) {\n    // delete from cursor to start of line (Cmd+Delete)\n    let col = s.cursor_col;\n    if col == 0 {\n        if s.cursor_line > 0 {\n            s.lines.remove(s.cursor_line);\n            s.cursor_line -= 1;\n            s.cursor_col = s.lines[s.cursor_line].chars().count();\n        }\n        return;\n    }\n    let line = &mut s.lines[s.cursor_line];\n    let byte_idx = char_to_byte_idx(line, col);\n    line.drain(..byte_idx);\n    s.cursor_col = 0;\n}\n\npub fn input_move_left(s: &mut InputState) {\n    s.selection = None;\n    if s.cursor_col > 0 {\n        s.cursor_col -= 1;\n    } else if s.cursor_line > 0 {\n        s.cursor_line -= 1;\n        s.cursor_col = s.lines[s.cursor_line].chars().count();\n    }\n}\n\npub fn input_move_right(s: &mut InputState) {\n    s.selection = None;\n    let line_len = s.lines[s.cursor_line].chars().count();\n    if s.cursor_col < line_len {\n        s.cursor_col += 1;\n    } else if s.cursor_line + 1 < s.lines.len() {\n        s.cursor_line += 1;\n        s.cursor_col = 0;\n    }\n}\n\npub fn input_move_up(s: &mut InputState) {\n    s.selection = None;\n    if s.cursor_line > 0 {\n        s.cursor_line -= 1;\n        let line_len = s.lines[s.cursor_line].chars().count();\n        s.cursor_col = s.cursor_col.min(line_len);\n    }\n}\n\npub fn input_move_down(s: &mut InputState) {\n    s.selection = None;\n    if s.cursor_line + 1 < s.lines.len() {\n        s.cursor_line += 1;\n        let line_len = s.lines[s.cursor_line].chars().count();\n        s.cursor_col = s.cursor_col.min(line_len);\n    }\n}\n\nfn delete_selection(s: &mut InputState, sel: &Selection) {\n    // Normalize selection\n    let (sl, sc, el, ec) = if (sel.start_line, sel.start_col) < (sel.end_line, sel.end_col) {\n        (sel.start_line, sel.start_col, sel.end_line, sel.end_col)\n    } else {\n        (sel.end_line, sel.end_col, sel.start_line, sel.start_col)\n    };\n    if sl == el {\n        let line = &mut s.lines[sl];\n        let b_start = char_to_byte_idx(line, sc);\n        let b_end = char_to_byte_idx(line, ec);\n        line.drain(b_start..b_end);\n    } else {\n s.lines.drain(sl+1..=el);\n    }\n    s.cursor_line = sl;\n    s.cursor_col = sc;\n}\n\nfn char_to_byte_idx(s: &str, char_idx: usize) -> usize {\n    s.char_indices().nth(char_idx).map(|(b, _)| b).unwrap_or(s.len())\n}\n\nfn prev_char_boundary(s: &str, byte_idx: usize) -> usize {\n    let mut i = byte_idx.saturating_sub(1);\n    while i > 0 && !s.is_char_boundary(i) { i -= 1; }\n    i\n}\n\n// Render the input bar widget\npub fn render_input(\n    f: &mut ratatui::Frame,\n    state: &InputState,\n    area: ratatui::layout::Rect,\n    focused: bool,\n) {\n    use ratatui::{\n (sel.end_line, sel.end_col, sel.start_line, sel.start_col)\n                };\n                if li < sl || li > el { false }\n                else if li == sl && li == el { ci >= sc && ci < ec }\n state.cursor_col == chars.len() {\n            spans.push(Span::styled(\" \", Style::default().bg(Color::White).fg(Color::Black)));\n        }\n        Line::from(spans)\n    }).collect();\n\n    let block = Block::default()\n        .borders(Borders::ALL)\n        .border_type(BorderType::Rounded)\n        .border_style(border_style)\n        .title(Span::styled(\" > \", Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)));\n\n    let para = Paragraph::new(text_lines).block(block);\n    f.render_widget(para, area);\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 4: Wire input events to Implement chat widget**\n\n```rust\n// rust/crates/app/src/ui/chat.rs\nuse ratatui::{\n    Frame,\n    layout::Rect,\n    style::{Color, Style, Modifier},\n    text::{Line, Span},\n    widgets::{Block, Borders, BorderType, Paragraph},\n};\nuse crate::state::{ChatMessage, MessageRole, TabState};\n\npub fn role_style(role: &MessageRole) -> Style {\n    match role {\n        MessageRole::User => Style::default().fg(Color::Green),\n        MessageRole::Assistant => Style::default().fg(Color::White),\n        MessageRole::System => Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray),\n    }\n}\n\npub fn render_chat(f: &mut Frame, tab: &TabState, area: Rect) {\n    let block = Block::default()\n        .borders(Borders::ALL)\n        .border_type(BorderType::Rounded)\n        .border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray));\n\n    let inner = block.inner(area);\n    f.render_widget(block, area);\n\n    if tab.messages.is_empty() && tab.streaming.is_none() {\n        let placeholder = Paragraph::new(\"Start a conversation...\")\n            .style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray));\n        f.render_widget(placeholder, inner);\n        return;\n    }\n\n    let mut lines: Vec<Line> = Vec::new();\n\n    for msg in &tab.messages {\n        let prefix = match msg.role {\n            MessageRole::User => \"You: \",\n            MessageRole::Assistant => \"Claude: \",\n            MessageRole::System => \"System: \",\n        };\n        let style = role_style(&msg.role);\n        lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(prefix, style.add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD))));\n        for content_line in msg.content.lines() {\n            lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(\n                format!(\"  {}\", content_line),\n                Style::default().fg(Color::White),\n            )));\n        }\n        lines.push(Line::default()); // blank separator\n    }\n\n    // Streaming in-progress\n    if let Some(chunk) = &tab.streaming {\n        lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(\"Claude: \", Style::default().fg(Color::White).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD))));\n        for content_line in chunk.lines() {\n            lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(\n                format!(\"  {}\", content_line),\n                Style::default().fg(Color::White),\n            )));\n        }\n        // Blinking cursor indicator\n        lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(\"  ▊\", Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan))));\n    }\n\n    // Auto-scroll to bottom\n    let total_lines = lines.len();\n    let visible_height = inner.height as usize;\n    let scroll = if total_lines > visible_height {\n        (total_lines - visible_height) as u16\n    } else {\n        0\n    };\n\n    let para = Paragraph::new(lines).scroll((scroll, 0));\n    f.render_widget(para, inner);\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 4: Implement agent task**\n\n```rust\n// rust/crates/app/src/agent_task.rs\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::sync::mpsc;\nuse clui_agent::{AgentClient, AgentConfig, AgentEvent};\nuse crate::event::AppEvent;\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum AgentCommand {\n    SendPrompt { text: String },\n    Interrupt,\n}\n\npub fn spawn_agent(\n    tab_id: String,\n    config: AgentConfig,\n    event_tx: mpsc::Sender<AppEvent>,\n) -> Arc<mpsc::Sender<AgentCommand>> {\n    let (cmd_tx, mut cmd_rx) = mpsc::channel::<AgentCommand>(32);\n\n    tokio::spawn(async move {\n        let mut client = AgentClient::new(config);\n        loop {\n            match cmd_rx.recv().await {\n                None => break,\n                Some(AgentCommand::Interrupt) => {\n                    // TODO: cancel in-flight request\n                }\n                Some(AgentCommand::SendPrompt { text }) => {\n                    let (chunk_tx, mut chunk_rx) = mpsc::channel::<AgentEvent>(128);\n                    let tid = tab_id.clone();\n                    let etx = event_tx.clone();\n\n                    // Forward events to main loop\n                    tokio::spawn(async move {\n                        while let Some(evt) = chunk_rx.recv().await {\n                            let app_event = match evt {\n                                AgentEvent::StreamChunk(content) => AppEvent::AgentChunk {\n                                    tab_id: tid.clone(), content,\n                                },\n                                AgentEvent::MessageComplete { content, output_tokens } => AppEvent::AgentComplete {\n                                    tab_id: tid.clone(), content, tokens: output_tokens, cost: 0.0,\n                                },\n                                AgentEvent::Error(message) => AppEvent::AgentError {\n                                    tab_id: tid.clone(), message,\n                                },\n                            };\n                            let _ = etx.send(app_event).await;\n                        }\n                    });\n\n                    if let Err(e) = client.send(text, None, chunk_tx).await {\n                        let _ = event_tx.send(AppEvent::AgentError {\n                            tab_id: tab_id.clone(),\n                            message: e.to_string(),\n                        }).await;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    });\n\n    Arc::new(cmd_tx)\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 5: Wire agent spawn in main loop and event forwarding**\n\n```rust\n// rust/crates/app/src/main.rs — replace run_loop with async version using mpsc:\n\nuse {\n        terminal.draw(|f| ui::render(f, state))?;\n\n        // Drain all pending async events first (non-blocking)\n        while let Ok(evt) = event_rx.try_recv() {\n            router::handle(state, evt);\n        }\n\n        if event::poll(std::time::Duration::from_millis(16))? {\n            match event::read()? {\n                Event::Key(k) => router::handle(state, AppEvent::Tick);\n        }\n\n        // When user submits (Enter in input), send to agent\n        // router sets tab.pending_prompt; we drain it here\n        if let Some(tab) = tx.send(crate::agent_task::AgentCommand::SendPrompt { text: prompt }).await;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if state.should_quit { break; }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n```\n\nAdd pins.is_empty() {\n        let hint = Paragraph::new(\"No context — @file /skill to pin\")\n            .style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray));\n        f.render_widget(hint, inner);\n        return;\n    }\n\n    let mut spans: Vec<Span> = Vec::new();\n    let selected_idx = tab.map(|t| t.pin_selected).unwrap_or(0);\n\n    for (i, pin) in pins.iter().enumerate() {\n        let selected = i == selected_idx;\n        let base_style = if selected {\n            Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan)\n        } else if pin.sticky {\n            Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan)\n        } else {\n            Style::default().fg(Color::Yellow)\n        };\n        let label = format!(\"{}{}\", pin_icon(&pin.kind), truncate_path(&pin.display));\n        let suffix = if !pin.sticky { \" (1x)\" } else { \"\" };\n        spans.push(Span::styled(format!(\"[{}{}] \", label, suffix), base_style));\n    }\n\n    let para = Paragraph::new(Line::from(spans));\n    f.render_widget(para, inner);\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 3: Add Alt+Left/Right pin navigation and Alt+X remove to router**\n\n```rust\n// In router.rs handle(), add pin navigation in the Input focus block:\n(Left, m) if tests module or separate file\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    #[test]\n    fn ignores_node_modules() {\n        let nodes = load_file_tree_flat(std::path::Path::new(\"/tmp\"), 0, loading**\n\nAdd to `state.rs` or a new `rust/crates/app/src/filetree.rs`:\n\n```rust\n// rust/crates/app/src/filetree.rs\nuse crate::state::FileNode;\nuse std::path::Path;\n\nconst IGNORE: &[&str] = &[\"node_modules\", \".git\", \"dist\", \"coverage\", \"target\", \".next\", \"build\", \"__pycache__\"];\n\npub fn load_children(parent: &Path, depth: usize) -> Vec<FileNode> {\n    let Ok(mut entries) = std::fs::read_dir(parent) else { return Vec::new() };\n    let mut nodes: Vec<FileNode> = entries\n        .filter_map(|e| e.ok())\n        .filter(|e| {\n            let name = e.file_name();\n            let name_str = name.to_string_lossy();\n            !name_str.starts_with('.') || name_str == \".claude\"\n        })\n        .filter(|e| {\n            let name = e.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();\n            !IGNORE.contains(&name.as_str())\n        })\n        .map(|e| {\n            let path = e.path();\n            let is_dir = path.is_dir();\n            let name = e.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();\n            let ext = path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()).unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n            FileNode { name, path: path.to_string_lossy().to_string(), depth, is_dir, expanded: false, pinned: false, extension: ext }\n        })\n        .collect();\n    nodes.sort_by(|a, b| {\n        b.is_dir.cmp(&a.is_dir).then(a.name.cmp(&b.name))\n    });\n    nodes\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 3: Implement files panel render**\n\n```rust\n// rust/crates/app/src/ui/files.rs\nuse ratatui::{\n    Frame, layout::Rect,\n    style::{Color, Style, Modifier},\n    text::{Line, Span},\n    widgets::{Block, Borders, BorderType, Paragraph},\n};\nuse crate::state::{AppState, FileNode};\n\nfn file_icon(node: &FileNode) -> &'static str {\n    if node.is_dir {\n        if node.expanded { \"📂\" } else { \"📁\" }\n    } else {\n        match node.extension.as_str() {\n            \"ts\" | \"tsx\" => \"TS\",\n            \"js\" | \"jsx\" => \"JS\",\n            \"json\" => \"{}\",\n            \"md\" => \"MD\",\n            \"rs\" => \"RS\",\n            \"toml\" => \"TM\",\n            \"yaml\" | \"yml\" => \"YM\",\n            _ => \"  \",\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn file_icon_color(node: &FileNode) -> Color {\n    if node.is_dir { Color::Blue }\n    else { match node.extension.as_str() {\n        \"ts\" | \"tsx\" => Color::Cyan,\n        \"js\" | \"jsx\" => Color::Yellow,\n        \"json\" => Color::Green,\n        \"md\" => Color::White,\n        \"rs\" => Color::Red,\n        _ => Color::Gray,\n    }}\n}\n\npub fn render_files(f: &mut Frame, state: &AppState, area: Rect) {\n    let block = Block::default()\n        .borders(Borders::ALL)\n        .border_type(BorderType::Rounded)\n        .border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray));\n    let inner = block.inner(area);\n    f.render_widget(block, area);\n\n    let files = &state.files;\n    let visible_height = inner.height as usize;\n    let start = files.scroll;\n    let end = (start + visible_height).min(files.nodes.len());\n\n    let lines: Vec<Line> = files.nodes[start..end].iter().enumerate().map(|(i, node)| {\n        let abs_i = start + i;\n        let selected = abs_i == files.selected;\n        let indent = \"  \".repeat(node.depth);\n        let pin_indicator = if node.pinned {\n            Span::styled(\"* \", Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan))\n        } else if selected {\n            Span::styled(\"+ \", Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray))\n        } else {\n            Span::raw(\"  \")\n        };\n        let icon_style = Style::default().fg(file_icon_color(node));\n        let name_style = if selected {\n            Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)\n        } else {\n            Style::default().fg(Color::White)\n        };\n        Line::from(vec![\n            Span::raw(indent),\n            pin_indicator,\n            Span::styled(format!(\"{} \", file_icon(node)), icon_style),\n            Span::styled(node.name.clone(), name_style),\n        ])\n    }).collect();\n\n    let para = Paragraph::new(lines);\n    f.render_widget(para, inner);\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 4: Add files panel key handlers to router**\n\n```rust\n// When focus is LeftSidebar and left_panel == Files:\nAppEvent::Key { code: KeyCode::Up, .. } => {\n    if state.files.selected > 0 { state.files.selected -= 1; }\n    // scroll up if needed\n    if state.files.selected < state.files.scroll { state.files.scroll = state.files.selected; }\n}\nAppEvent::Key { code: KeyCode::Down, .. } => {\n    if state.files.selected + 1 < state.files.nodes.len() { state.files.selected state.files.nodes.splice(idx+1..idx+1, children);\n            } else {\n                // collapse: remove all children (depth > node.depth following this idx)\n                let depth = state.files.nodes[idx].depth;\n                let mut end = idx + 1;\n                while end < state.files.nodes.len() && state.files.nodes[end].depth > depth {\n                    end += 1;\n                }\n                state.files.nodes.drain(idx+1..end);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\nAppEvent::Key { code: KeyCode::Char('p'), modifiers } if modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT) => {\n    let idx = state.files.selected;\n    if let Some(node) = state.files.nodes.get_mut(idx) {\n        node.pinned = !node.pinned;\n        if node.pinned {\n            if let Some(tab) =        path: node.path.clone(),\n                    display: node.name.clone(),\n                    sticky: true,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 5: 1	# clui Rust Rewrite — Implementation Plan
2	
3	> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.
4	
5	**Goal:** Rewrite clui TUI from TypeScript/Ink to Rust/Ratatui — full feature parity with `docs/FEATURES.md`, single binary, single process with tokio tasks.
6	
7	**Architecture:** Single Rust process. `AppState` owned by the main loop (`Arc<Mutex<AppState>>`). Each tab's agent is a `tokio::spawn` task communicating via `mpsc` channels. No IPC, no Unix sockets, no Node.js dependency.
8	
9	**Tech Stack:** Rust 2021, ratatui 0.29, crossterm 0.28, tokio 1, reqwest 0.12 (SSE streaming), git2 0.19, rusqlite 0.32, syntect 5, serde_json, notify 6, dirs 5, anyhow 1

321	// rust/crates/config/src/lib.rs
322	use std::path::PathBuf;
323	
324	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
325	pub struct Paths {
326	    pub socket_dir: PathBuf,
327	    pub db_path: PathBuf,
328	    pub claude_projects_dir: PathBuf,
329	    pub claude_skills_dir: PathBuf,  // ~/.claude/skills/
330	    pub global_skills_dir: PathBuf,  // ~/.claude/plugins/ (global)
331	}
332	
333	impl Paths {
334	    pub fn new() -> Self {
335	        let home = dirs::home_dir().expect("no home dir");
336	        let tmp = std::env::temp_dir();
337	        Self {
338	            socket_dir: tmp.join("clui"),
339	            db_path: home.join(".claude").join("clui.db"),
340	            claude_projects_dir: home.join(".claude").join("projects"),
341	            claude_skills_dir: home.join(".claude").join("skills"),
342	            global_skills_dir: home.join(".claude").join("plugins").join("cache"),
343	        }
344	    }
345	}
346

348	    fn default() -> Self { Self::new() }
349	}

423	use anyhow::Result;
424	use rusqlite::{Connection, params};
425	use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
426	
427	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
428	pub struct Session {
429	    pub id: String,
430	    pub name: String,
431	    pub created_at: String,
432	}
433	
434	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
435	pub struct StoredMessage {
436	    pub id: i64,
437	    pub session_id: String,
438	    pub role: String,
439	    pub content: String,
440	    pub tokens: Option<i64>,
441	    pub cost: Option<f64>,
442	    pub created_at: String,
443	}
444	
445	pub struct Db {
446	    conn: Connection,
447	}
448	
449	impl Db {
450	    pub fn open(path: &std::path::Path) -> Result<Self> {
451	        let conn = Connection::open(path)?;
452	        let db = Self { conn };
453	        db.migrate()?;
454	        Ok(db)
455	    }
456	
457	    pub fn open_in_memory() -> Result<Self> {
458	        let conn = Connection::open_in_memory()?;
459	        let db = Self { conn };
460	        db.migrate()?;
461	        Ok(db)
462	    }
463	
464	    fn migrate(&self) -> Result<()> {
465	        self.conn.execute_batch("
466	            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
467	                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
468	                name TEXT NOT NULL,
469	                created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
470	            );
471	            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (
472	                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
473	                session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
474	                role TEXT NOT NULL,
475	                content TEXT NOT NULL,
476	                tokens INTEGER,
477	                cost REAL,
478	                created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
479	            );
480	        ")?;
481	        Ok(())
482	    }
483	
484	    pub fn session_count(&self) -> Result<i64> {
485	        Ok(self.conn.query_row(
486	            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions", [], |r| r.get(0)
487	        )?)
488	    }
489	
490	    pub fn create_session(&self, id: &str, name: &str) -> Result<()> {
491	        self.conn.execute(
492	            "INSERT INTO sessions (id, name) VALUES (?1, ?2)",
493	            params![id, name],
494	        )?;
495	        Ok(())
496	    }
497	
498	    pub fn list_sessions(&self) -> Result<Vec<Session>> {
499	        let mut stmt = self.conn.prepare(
500	            "SELECT id, name, created_at FROM sessions ORDER BY created_at DESC"
501	        )?;
502	        let rows = stmt.query_map([], |r| Ok(Session {
503	            id: r.get(0)?,
504	            name: r.get(1)?,
505	            created_at: r.get(2)?,
506	        }))?;
507	        Ok(rows.collect::<rusqlite::Result<Vec<_>>>()?)
508	    }
509	
510	    pub fn insert_message(&self, session_id: &str, role: &str, content: &str,
511	                           tokens: Option<i64>, cost: Option<f64>) -> Result<()> {
512	        self.conn.execute(
513	            "INSERT INTO messages (session_id, role, content, tokens, cost) VALUES (?1,?2,?3,?4,?5)",
514	            params![session_id, role, content, tokens, cost],
515	        )?;
516	        Ok(())
517	    }
518	
519	    pub fn messages_for_session(&self, session_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<StoredMessage>> {
520	        let mut stmt = self.conn.prepare(
521	            "SELECT id, session_id, role, content, tokens, cost, created_at
522	             FROM messages WHERE session_id=?1 ORDER BY id ASC"
523	        )?;
524	        let rows = stmt.query_map(params![session_id], |r| Ok(StoredMessage {
525	            id: r.get(0)?,
526	            session_id: r.get(1)?,
527	            role: r.get(2)?,
528	            content: r.get(3)?,
529	            tokens: r.get(4)?,
530	            cost: r.get(5)?,
531	            created_at: r.get(6)?,
532	        }))?;
533	        Ok(rows.collect::<rusqlite::Result<Vec<_>>>()?)
534	    }
535	}

608	```rust
609	// rust/crates/agent/src/stream.rs
610	use anyhow::Result;
611	use serde::Deserialize;
612	
613	#[derive(Debug, PartialEq)]
614	pub enum SseEvent {
615	    TextDelta(String),
616	    MessageDelta { output_tokens: u32 },
617	    MessageStop,
618	    Unknown,
619	}
620	
621	#[derive(Deserialize)]
622	struct RawEvent {
623	    #[serde(rename = "type")]
624	    event_type: String,
625	    delta: Option<RawDelta>,
626	    usage: Option<RawUsage>,
627	}
628	
629	#[derive(Deserialize)]
630	struct RawDelta {
631	    #[serde(rename = "type")]
632	    delta_type: Option<String>,
633	    text: Option<String>,
634	}
635	
636	#[derive(Deserialize)]
637	struct RawUsage {
638	    output_tokens: Option<u32>,
639	}
640	
641	pub fn parse_sse_data(data: &str) -> Result<SseEvent> {
642	    let raw: RawEvent = serde_json::from_str(data)?;
643	    Ok(match raw.event_type.as_str() {
644	        "content_block_delta" => {
645	            if let Some(delta) = raw.delta {
646	                if delta.delta_type.as_deref() == Some("text_delta") {
647	                    return Ok(SseEvent::TextDelta(delta.text.unwrap_or_default()));
648	                }
649	            }
650	            SseEvent::Unknown
651	        }
652	        "message_delta" => SseEvent::MessageDelta {
653	            output_tokens: raw.usage.and_then(|u| u.output_tokens).unwrap_or(0),
654	        },
655	        "message_stop" => SseEvent::MessageStop,
656	        _ => SseEvent::Unknown,
657	    })
658	}
659	```

688	#[derive(Debug)]
689	pub enum AgentEvent {
690	    StreamChunk(String),
691	    MessageComplete { content: String, output_tokens: u32 },
692	    Error(String),
693	}
694	
695	pub struct AgentClient {
696	    config: AgentConfig,
697	    http: Client,
698	    history: Vec<ApiMessage>,
699	}
700	
701	impl AgentClient {
702	    pub fn new(config: AgentConfig) -> Self {
703	        Self {
704	            config,
705	            http: Client::new(),
706	            history: Vec::new(),
707	        }
708	    }
709	
710	    pub fn reset(&mut self) {
711	        self.history.clear();
712	    }
713	
714	    /// Send a prompt and stream events back via `tx`.
715	    pub async fn send(&mut self, prompt: String, system: Option<String>,
716	                      tx: mpsc::Sender<AgentEvent>) -> Result<()> {
717	        self.history.push(ApiMessage { role: "user".into(), content: prompt });
718	
719	        #[derive(Serialize)]
720	        struct Body<'a> {
721	            model: &'a str,
722	            max_tokens: u32,
723	            stream: bool,
724	            messages: &'a [ApiMessage],
725	            #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
726	            system: Option<&'a str>,
727	        }
728	
729	        let body = Body {
730	            model: &self.config.model,
731	            max_tokens: self.config.max_tokens,
732	            stream: true,
733	            messages: &self.history,
734	            system: system.as_deref(),
735	        };
736	
737	        let response = self.http
738	            .post("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages")
739	            .header("x-api-key", &self.config.api_key)
740	            .header("anthropic-version", "2023-06-01")
741	            .header("content-type", "application/json")
742	            .json(&body)
743	            .send()
744	            .await
745	            .context("failed to connect to Anthropic API")?;
746	
747	        if !response.status().is_success() {
748	            let status = response.status();
749	            let body = response.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
750	            let _ = tx.send(AgentEvent::Error(format!("API error {status}: {body}"))).await;
751	            return Ok(());
752	        }
753	
754	        let mut full_content = String::new();
755	        let mut output_tokens = 0u32;
756	        let mut stream = response.bytes_stream().eventsource();
757	
758	        while let Some(event_result) = stream.next().await {
759	            match event_result {
760	                Ok(event) => {
761	                    if event.data == "[DONE]" { break; }
762	                    match parse_sse_data(&event.data) {
763	                        Ok(SseEvent::TextDelta(text)) => {
764	                            full_content.push_str(&text);
765	                            let _ = tx.send(AgentEvent::StreamChunk(text)).await;
766	                        }
767	                        Ok(SseEvent::MessageDelta { output_tokens: n }) => {
768	                            output_tokens = n;
769	                        }
770	                        Ok(SseEvent::MessageStop) => break,
771	                        _ => {}
772	                    }
773	                }
774	                Err(e) => {
775	                    let _ = tx.send(AgentEvent::Error(e.to_string())).await;
776	                    break;
777	                }
778	            }
779	        }
780	
781	        self.history.push(ApiMessage { role: "assistant".into(), content: full_content.clone() });
782	        let _ = tx.send(AgentEvent::MessageComplete { content: full_content, output_tokens }).await;
783	        Ok(())
784	    }
785	}

853	```rust
854	// rust/crates/git/src/lib.rs
855	use anyhow::{Context, Result};
856	use git2::{Repository, StatusOptions, Delta};
857	use std::path::Path;
858	
859	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
860	pub enum FileStatus { Modified, Added, Deleted, Renamed, Untracked }
861	
862	impl FileStatus {
863	    pub fn from_delta(delta: Delta) -> Self {
864	        match delta {
865	            Delta::Added => Self::Added,
866	            Delta::Deleted => Self::Deleted,
867	            Delta::Renamed => Self::Renamed,
868	            _ => Self::Modified,
869	        }
870	    }
871	}
872	
873	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
874	pub struct DiffEntry {
875	    pub path: String,
876	    pub status: FileStatus,
877	    pub staged: bool,
878	}
879	
880	impl DiffEntry {
881	    pub fn status_char(&self) -> char {
882	        match self.status {
883	            FileStatus::Modified => 'M',
884	            FileStatus::Added => 'A',
885	            FileStatus::Deleted => 'D',
886	            FileStatus::Renamed => 'R',
887	            FileStatus::Untracked => '?',
888	        }
889	    }
890	}
891	
892	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
893	pub struct GitStatusResult {
894	    pub branch: String,
895	    pub staged: Vec<DiffEntry>,
896	    pub unstaged: Vec<DiffEntry>,
897	}
898	
899	pub fn git_status(cwd: &Path) -> Result<GitStatusResult> {
900	    let repo = Repository::discover(cwd)
901	        .context("not a git repository")?;
902	
903	    let branch = repo.head()
904	        .ok()
905	        .and_then(|h| h.shorthand().map(|s| s.to_string()))
906	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "HEAD".to_string());
907	
908	    let mut opts = StatusOptions::new();
909	    opts.include_untracked(true).recurse_untracked_dirs(true);
910	    let statuses = repo.statuses(Some(&mut opts))?;
911	
912	    let mut staged = Vec::new();
913	    let mut unstaged = Vec::new();
914	
915	    for entry in statuses.iter() {
916	        let path = entry.path().unwrap_or("").to_string();
917	        let s = entry.status();
918	
919	        if s.contains(git2::Status::INDEX_MODIFIED) || s.contains(git2::Status::INDEX_NEW) || s.contains(git2::Status::INDEX_DELETED) {
920	            let status = if s.contains(git2::Status::INDEX_NEW) { FileStatus::Added }
921	                else if s.contains(git2::Status::INDEX_DELETED) { FileStatus::Deleted }
922	                else { FileStatus::Modified };
923	            staged.push(DiffEntry { path: path.clone(), status, staged: true });
924	        }
925	
926	        if s.contains(git2::Status::WT_MODIFIED) || s.contains(git2::Status::WT_DELETED) {
927	            let status = if s.contains(git2::Status::WT_DELETED) { FileStatus::Deleted }
928	                else { FileStatus::Modified };
929	            unstaged.push(DiffEntry { path: path.clone(), status, staged: false });
930	        }
931	
932	        if s.contains(git2::Status::WT_NEW) {
933	            unstaged.push(DiffEntry { path: path.clone(), status: FileStatus::Untracked, staged: false });
934	        }
935	    }
936	
937	    Ok(GitStatusResult { branch, staged, unstaged })
938	}
939	
940	pub fn stage_file(cwd: &Path, path: &str) -> Result<()> {
941	    let repo = Repository::discover(cwd)?;
942	    let mut index = repo.index()?;
943	    index.add_path(Path::new(path))?;
944	    index.write()?;
945	    Ok(())
946	}
947	
948	pub fn unstage_file(cwd: &Path, path: &str) -> Result<()> {
949	    let repo = Repository::discover(cwd)?;
950	    let head = repo.head().ok().and_then(|h| h.peel_to_commit().ok());
951	    match head {
952	        Some(_) => {
953	            let head_obj = repo.revparse_single("HEAD")?;
954	            repo.reset_default(Some(&head_obj), &[Path::new(path)])?;
955	        }
956	        None => {
957	            // no commits yet, just remove from index
958	            let mut index = repo.index()?;
959	            index.remove_path(Path::new(path))?;
960	            index.write()?;
961	        }
962	    }
963	    Ok(())
964	}
965	
966	pub fn discard_file(cwd: &Path, path: &str) -> Result<()> {
967	    let repo = Repository::discover(cwd)?;
968	    let mut checkout = git2::build::CheckoutBuilder::new();
969	    checkout.path(path).force();
970	    repo.checkout_head(Some(&mut checkout))?;
971	    Ok(())
972	}
973	
974	pub fn file_diff(cwd: &Path, path: &str, staged: bool) -> Result<String> {
975	    let repo = Repository::discover(cwd)?;
976	    let mut diff_opts = git2::DiffOptions::new();
977	    diff_opts.pathspec(path);
978	
979	    let diff = if staged {
980	        let head_tree = repo.head().ok()
981	            .and_then(|h| h.peel_to_commit().ok())
982	            .and_then(|c| c.tree().ok());
983	        let index = repo.index()?;
984	        repo.diff_tree_to_index(head_tree.as_ref(), Some(&index), Some(&mut diff_opts))?
985	    } else {
986	        repo.diff_index_to_workdir(None, Some(&mut diff_opts))?
987	    };
988	
989	    let mut output = String::new();
990	    diff.print(git2::DiffFormat::Patch, |_, _, line| {
991	        let content = std::str::from_utf8(line.content()).unwrap_or("");
992	        output.push_str(content);
993	        true
994	    })?;
995	    Ok(output)
996	}
997	```

1457	```rust
1458	// rust/crates/app/src/router.rs
1459	use crossterm::event::{KeyCode, KeyModifiers};
1460	use crate::{state::AppState, event::AppEvent};
1461	
1462	pub fn handle(state: &mut AppState, event: AppEvent) {
1463	    match event {
1464	        AppEvent::Key { code: KeyCode::Char('q'), modifiers } if modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
1465	            state.should_quit = true;
1466	        }
1467	        AppEvent::Resize { cols, rows } => {
1468	            state.layout.terminal_cols = cols;
1469	            state.layout.terminal_rows = rows;
1470	        }
1471	        AppEvent::Tick => {
1472	            // expire old notifications
1473	            state.notifications.retain(|n| !n.is_expired());
1474	        }
1475	        AppEvent::AgentChunk { tab_id, content } => {
1476	            if let Some(tab) = state.tabs.iter_mut().find(|t| t.id == tab_id) {
1477	                tab.streaming.get_or_insert_default().push_str(&content);
1478	            }
1479	        }
1480	        AppEvent::AgentComplete { tab_id, content, tokens, cost } => {
1481	            if let Some(tab) = state.tabs.iter_mut().find(|t| t.id == tab_id) {
1482	                tab.streaming = None;
1483	                tab.messages.push(crate::state::ChatMessage {
1484	                    role: crate::state::MessageRole::Assistant,
1485	                    content,
1486	                });
1487	                tab.status.context_tokens += tokens;
1488	                tab.status.cost += cost;
1489	            }
1490	        }
1491	        AppEvent::AgentError { tab_id, message } => {
1492	            if let Some(tab) = state.tabs.iter_mut().find(|t| t.id == tab_id) {
1493	                tab.streaming = None;
1494	            }
1495	            state.notifications.push(crate::state::NotificationEntry {
1496	                message,
1497	                kind: crate::state::NotificationKind::Error,
1498	                created_at: std::time::Instant::now(),
1499	                ttl_secs: 5,
1500	            });
1501	        }
1502	        _ => {}
1503	    }
1504	}
1505	```

1691	// rust/crates/app/src/ui/layout.rs
1692	use ratatui::{
1693	    Frame,
1694	    layout::{Constraint, Direction, Layout, Rect},
1695	    style::{Color, Style, Modifier},
1696	    text::{Line, Span},
1697	    widgets::{Block, Borders, BorderType, Paragraph, Tabs},
1698	};
1699	use crate::state::{AppState, LayoutState, TabKind};
1700	
1701	pub struct ColumnAreas {
1702	    pub tab_bar: Rect,
1703	    pub left: Rect,
1704	    pub center: Rect,
1705	    pub right: Rect,
1706	}
1707	
1708	pub fn compute_columns(layout: &LayoutState, area: Rect) -> ColumnAreas {
1709	    // Top row: tab bar (1 line)
1710	    let vertical = Layout::vertical([Constraint::Length(3), Constraint::Min(0)]).split(area);
1711	    let tab_bar = vertical[0];
1712	    let body = vertical[1];
1713	
1714	    let left_w = if layout.left_visible { layout.left_width() } else { 0 };
1715	    let right_w = if layout.right_visible { layout.right_width() } else { 0 };
1716	    let center_w = body.width.saturating_sub(left_w + right_w);
1717	
1718	    let cols = Layout::horizontal([
1719	        Constraint::Length(left_w),
1720	        Constraint::Length(center_w),
1721	        Constraint::Length(right_w),
1722	    ]).split(body);
1723	
1724	    ColumnAreas { tab_bar, left: cols[0], center: cols[1], right: cols[2] }
1725	}
1726	
1727	pub fn render_tab_bar(f: &mut Frame, state: &AppState, area: Rect) {
1728	    let titles: Vec<Line> = state.tabs.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, tab)| {
1729	        let style = if i == state.active_tab {
1730	            Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
1731	        } else {
1732	            Style::default().fg(Color::Gray)
1733	        };
1734	        Line::from(Span::styled(format!(" {} ", tab.name), style))
1735	    }).collect();
1736	
1737	    let tabs = Tabs::new(titles)
1738	        .block(Block::default().borders(Borders::ALL).border_type(BorderType::Rounded))
1739	        .select(state.active_tab)
1740	        .highlight_style(Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD))
1741	        .divider("|");
1742	    f.render_widget(tabs, area);
1743	}
1744	```

1937	// rust/crates/app/src/ui/input.rs
1938	use crate::state::{InputState, Selection};
1939	
1940	pub fn input_char(s: &mut InputState, c: char) {
1941	    s.selection = None;
1942	    let line = &mut s.lines[s.cursor_line];
1943	    let byte_idx = char_to_byte_idx(line, s.cursor_col);
1944	    line.insert(byte_idx, c);
1945	    s.cursor_col += 1;
1946	}
1947	
1948	pub fn input_backspace(s: &mut InputState) {
1949	    if let Some(sel) = s.selection.take() {
1950	        delete_selection(s, &sel);
1951	        return;
1952	    }
1953	    if s.cursor_col > 0 {
1954	        let line = &mut s.lines[s.cursor_line];
1955	        let byte_idx = char_to_byte_idx(line, s.cursor_col);
1956	        let prev = prev_char_boundary(line, byte_idx);
1957	        line.drain(prev..byte_idx);
1958	        s.cursor_col -= 1;
1959	    } else if s.cursor_line > 0 {
1960	        let removed = s.lines.remove(s.cursor_line);
1961	        s.cursor_line -= 1;
1962	        let prev_len = s.lines[s.cursor_line].chars().count();
1963	        s.lines[s.cursor_line].push_str(&removed);
1964	        s.cursor_col = prev_len;
1965	    }
1966	}
1967	
1968	pub fn input_newline(s: &mut InputState) {
1969	    s.selection = None;
1970	    let line = s.lines[s.cursor_line].clone();
1971	    let byte_idx = char_to_byte_idx(&line, s.cursor_col);
1972	    let rest = line[byte_idx..].to_string();
1973	    s.lines[s.cursor_line].truncate(byte_idx);
1974	    s.cursor_line += 1;
1975	    s.lines.insert(s.cursor_line, rest);
1976	    s.cursor_col = 0;
1977	}
1978	
1979	pub fn input_delete_word_left(s: &mut InputState) {
1980	    let col = s.cursor_col;
1981	    if col == 0 { return input_backspace(s); }
1982	    let chars: Vec<char> = s.lines[s.cursor_line].chars().collect();
1983	    let mut i = col;
1984	    while i > 0 && chars[i-1] == ' ' { i -= 1; }
1985	    while i > 0 && chars[i-1] != ' ' { i -= 1; }
1986	    let line = &mut s.lines[s.cursor_line];
1987	    let b_start = char_to_byte_idx(line, i);
1988	    let b_end = char_to_byte_idx(line, col);
1989	    line.drain(b_start..b_end);
1990	    s.cursor_col = i;
1991	}
1992	
1993	pub fn input_delete_line(s: &mut InputState) {
1994	    // delete from cursor to start of line (Cmd+Delete)
1995	    let col = s.cursor_col;
1996	    if col == 0 {
1997	        if s.cursor_line > 0 {
1998	            s.lines.remove(s.cursor_line);
1999	            s.cursor_line -= 1;
2000	            s.cursor_col = s.lines[s.cursor_line].chars().count();
2001	        }
2002	        return;
2003	    }
2004	    let line = &mut s.lines[s.cursor_line];
2005	    let byte_idx = char_to_byte_idx(line, col);
2006	    line.drain(..byte_idx);
2007	    s.cursor_col = 0;
2008	}
2009	
2010	pub fn input_move_left(s: &mut InputState) {
2011	    s.selection = None;
2012	    if s.cursor_col > 0 {
2013	        s.cursor_col -= 1;
2014	    } else if s.cursor_line > 0 {
2015	        s.cursor_line -= 1;
2016	        s.cursor_col = s.lines[s.cursor_line].chars().count();
2017	    }
2018	}
2019	
2020	pub fn input_move_right(s: &mut InputState) {
2021	    s.selection = None;
2022	    let line_len = s.lines[s.cursor_line].chars().count();
2023	    if s.cursor_col < line_len {
2024	        s.cursor_col += 1;
2025	    } else if s.cursor_line + 1 < s.lines.len() {
2026	        s.cursor_line += 1;
2027	        s.cursor_col = 0;
2028	    }
2029	}
2030	
2031	pub fn input_move_up(s: &mut InputState) {
2032	    s.selection = None;
2033	    if s.cursor_line > 0 {
2034	        s.cursor_line -= 1;
2035	        let line_len = s.lines[s.cursor_line].chars().count();
2036	        s.cursor_col = s.cursor_col.min(line_len);
2037	    }
2038	}
2039	
2040	pub fn input_move_down(s: &mut InputState) {
2041	    s.selection = None;
2042	    if s.cursor_line + 1 < s.lines.len() {
2043	        s.cursor_line += 1;
2044	        let line_len = s.lines[s.cursor_line].chars().count();
2045	        s.cursor_col = s.cursor_col.min(line_len);
2046	    }
2047	}
2048	
2049	fn delete_selection(s: &mut InputState, sel: &Selection) {
2050	    // Normalize selection
2051	    let (sl, sc, el, ec) = if (sel.start_line, sel.start_col) < (sel.end_line, sel.end_col) {
2052	        (sel.start_line, sel.start_col, sel.end_line, sel.end_col)
2053	    } else {
2054	        (sel.end_line, sel.end_col, sel.start_line, sel.start_col)
2055	    };
2056	    if sl == el {
2057	        let line = &mut s.lines[sl];
2058	        let b_start = char_to_byte_idx(line, sc);
2059	        let b_end = char_to_byte_idx(line, ec);
2060	        line.drain(b_start..b_end);
2061	    } else {
2062	        let suffix = s.lines[el][char_to_byte_idx(&s.lines[el], ec)..].to_string();
2063	        s.lines[sl].truncate(char_to_byte_idx(&s.lines[sl], sc));
2064	        s.lines[sl].push_str(&suffix);
2065	        s.lines.drain(sl+1..=el);
2066	    }
2067	    s.cursor_line = sl;
2068	    s.cursor_col = sc;
2069	}
2070	
2071	fn char_to_byte_idx(s: &str, char_idx: usize) -> usize {
2072	    s.char_indices().nth(char_idx).map(|(b, _)| b).unwrap_or(s.len())
2073	}
2074	
2075	fn prev_char_boundary(s: &str, byte_idx: usize) -> usize {
2076	    let mut i = byte_idx.saturating_sub(1);
2077	    while i > 0 && !s.is_char_boundary(i) { i -= 1; }
2078	    i
2079	}
2080	
2081	// Render the input bar widget
2082	pub fn render_input(
2083	    f: &mut ratatui::Frame,
2084	    state: &InputState,
2085	    area: ratatui::layout::Rect,

2087	) {

2090	        text::{Line, Span},

2092	    };
2093	
2094	    let border_style = if focused {
2095	        Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan)

2097	        Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)
2098	    };
2099	
2100	    // Build lines with cursor and selection highlighting
2101	    let text_lines: Vec<Line> = state.lines.iter().enumerate().map(|(li, line)| {
2102	        let mut spans = Vec::new();
2103	        let chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();
2104	        for (ci, &ch) in chars.iter().enumerate() {
2105	            let is_cursor = li == state.cursor_line && ci == state.cursor_col;
2106	            let in_selection = state.selection.as_ref().map(|sel| {
2107	                let (sl, sc, el, ec) = if (sel.start_line, sel.start_col) < (sel.end_line, sel.end_col) {

2111	                };

2113	                else if li == sl && li == el { ci >= sc && ci < ec }
2114	                else if li == sl { ci >= sc }

2355	// rust/crates/app/src/agent_task.rs
2356	use std::sync::Arc;
2357	use tokio::sync::mpsc;
2358	use clui_agent::{AgentClient, AgentConfig, AgentEvent};
2359	use crate::event::AppEvent;
2360	
2361	#[derive(Debug)]
2362	pub enum AgentCommand {
2363	    SendPrompt { text: String },
2364	    Interrupt,
2365	}
2366	
2367	pub fn spawn_agent(
2368	    tab_id: String,
2369	    config: AgentConfig,
2370	    event_tx: mpsc::Sender<AppEvent>,
2371	) -> Arc<mpsc::Sender<AgentCommand>> {
2372	    let (cmd_tx, mut cmd_rx) = mpsc::channel::<AgentCommand>(32);
2373	
2374	    tokio::spawn(async move {
2375	        let mut client = AgentClient::new(config);
2376	        loop {
2377	            match cmd_rx.recv().await {
2378	                None => break,
2379	                Some(AgentCommand::Interrupt) => {
2380	                    // TODO: cancel in-flight request
2381	                }
2382	                Some(AgentCommand::SendPrompt { text }) => {
2383	                    let (chunk_tx, mut chunk_rx) = mpsc::channel::<AgentEvent>(128);
2384	                    let tid = tab_id.clone();
2385	                    let etx = event_tx.clone();
2386	
2387	                    // Forward events to main loop
2388	                    tokio::spawn(async move {
2389	                        while let Some(evt) = chunk_rx.recv().await {
2390	                            let app_event = match evt {
2391	                                AgentEvent::StreamChunk(content) => AppEvent::AgentChunk {
2392	                                    tab_id: tid.clone(), content,
2393	                                },
2394	                                AgentEvent::MessageComplete { content, output_tokens } => AppEvent::AgentComplete {
2395	                                    tab_id: tid.clone(), content, tokens: output_tokens, cost: 0.0,
2396	                                },
2397	                                AgentEvent::Error(message) => AppEvent::AgentError {
2398	                                    tab_id: tid.clone(), message,
2399	                                },
2400	                            };
2401	                            let _ = etx.send(app_event).await;
2402	                        }
2403	                    });
2404	
2405	                    if let Err(e) = client.send(text, None, chunk_tx).await {
2406	                        let _ = event_tx.send(AppEvent::AgentError {
2407	                            tab_id: tab_id.clone(),
2408	                            message: e.to_string(),
2409	                        }).await;
2410	                    }
2411	                }
2412	            }
2413	        }
2414	    });
2415	
2416	    Arc::new(cmd_tx)
2417	}

2632	        let suffix = if !pin.sticky { " (1x)" } else { "" };

3095	```rust
3096	// rust/crates/app/src/filetree.rs
3097	use crate::state::FileNode;
3098	use std::path::Path;
3099	
3100	const IGNORE: &[&str] = &["node_modules", ".git", "dist", "coverage", "target", ".next", "build", "__pycache__"];
3101	
3102	pub fn load_children(parent: &Path, depth: usize) -> Vec<FileNode> {
3103	    let Ok(mut entries) = std::fs::read_dir(parent) else { return Vec::new() };
3104	    let mut nodes: Vec<FileNode> = entries
3105	        .filter_map(|e| e.ok())
3106	        .filter(|e| {
3107	            let name = e.file_name();
3108	            let name_str = name.to_string_lossy();
3109	            !name_str.starts_with('.') || name_str == ".claude"
3110	        })
3111	        .filter(|e| {
3112	            let name = e.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
3113	            !IGNORE.contains(&name.as_str())
3114	        })
3115	        .map(|e| {
3116	            let path = e.path();
3117	            let is_dir = path.is_dir();
3118	            let name = e.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
3119	            let ext = path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()).unwrap_or("").to_string();
3120	            FileNode { name, path: path.to_string_lossy().to_string(), depth, is_dir, expanded: false, pinned: false, extension: ext }
3121	        })
3122	        .collect();
3123	    nodes.sort_by(|a, b| {
3124	        b.is_dir.cmp(&a.is_dir).then(a.name.cmp(&b.name))
3125	    });
3126	    nodes
3127	}

3386	pub fn render_right_sidebar(f: &mut Frame, state: &AppState, area: Rect) {
3387	    let layout = Layout::vertical([Constraint::Length(3), Constraint::Min(0)]).split(area);
3388	    let tab_area = layout[0];

3391	    // Two tab buttons: / Commands | MCPs
