3394	    let labels = ["/ Commands", "MCPs"];
3395	
3396	    for (i, (panel, label)) in panels.iter().zip(labels.iter()).enumerate() {
3397	        let active = &state.layout.right_panel == panel;
3398	        let border_style = if active { Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan) } else { Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray) };
3399	        let text_style = if active { Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD) } else { Style::default().fg(Color::Gray) };
3400	        let block = Block::default().borders(Borders::ALL)
3401	            .border_type(if active { BorderType::Rounded } else { BorderType::Plain })
3402	            .border_style(border_style);
3403	        let para = Paragraph::new(Line::from(Span::styled(*label, text_style)))
3404	            .block(block).alignment(ratatui::layout::Alignment::Center);
3405	        f.render_widget(para, tab_cols[i]);
3406	    }
3407	
3408	    match state.layout.right_panel {
3409	        RightPanel::Skills => super::skills::render_skills(f, state, content_area),
3410	        RightPanel::Mcps => {
3411	            let b = Block::default().borders(Borders::ALL).border_type(BorderType::Rounded)
3412	                .border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)).title(" MCPs ");
3413	            f.render_widget(b, content_area);
3414	        }
3415	    }
3416	}

depth: usize) -> Vec<FileNode> {\n    let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(parent) else {\n        return Vec::new();\n    };\n    let mut nodes: Vec<FileNode> = entries\n        .filter_map(|e| e.ok())\n        .filter(|e| {\n            let name = e.file_name();\n            let name_str = name.to_string_lossy();\n            !name_str.starts_with('.') || name_str == \".claude\"\n        })\n        .filter(|e| {\n            let name = e.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();\n            !IGNORE.contains(&name.as_str())\n        })\n        .map(|e| {\n            let path = .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                .unwrap_or(\"\")\n                .to_string();\n            FileNode {\n                name,\n                path: path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),\n                depth,\n                is_dir,\n                expanded: false,\n                pinned: false,\n                extension: ext,\n            }\n        })\n        .collect();\n    nodes.sort_by(|a, b| b.is_dir.cmp(&a.is_dir).then(a.name.cmp(&b.name)));\n    nodes\n}\n```\n\n### Update `rust/crates/app/src/ui/mod.rs`\n\nReplace completely:\n\n```rust\nmod chat;\nmod > AGENT

Claude.ai subscription and Anthropic API key are **separate products**. A subscription doesn't give API access.

To get an API key: [console.anthropic.com](https://console.anthropic.com) → API Keys (paid separately, usage-based).

---

However — the original TS version worked with your subscription because it used the **Claude Code SDK**, which runs the `claude` CLI under the hood. The Rust rewrite bypassed that and calls the API directly.

Two options:

**Option A** — Get an API key (console.anthropic.com). Pay per token.

**Option B** — Change the Rust agent to spawn the `claude` CLI as a subprocess (uses your subscription). This would work like:
```bash
claude --print "your prompt" --output-format stream-json
```

Option B means the Rust app still has no Node dependency itself, but requires `claude` CLI installed — which you already have since you're using Claude Code. Architecturally cleaner than paying twice.

Want me to switch the agent to Option B (use `claude` CLI subprocess)?

- `rust/crates/app/src/agent_task.rs` — use `CliAgentClient` instead of `AgentClient`
- `rust/crates/app/src/main.rs` — remove API key requirement

10	pub fn render_sessions(f: &mut Frame, state: &AppState, area: Rect) {
11	    let block = Block::default()
12	        .borders(Borders::ALL)
13	        .border_type(BorderType::Rounded)
14	        .border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray));
15	    let inner = block.inner(area);
16	    f.render_widget(block, area);
17	
18	    let mut lines: Vec<Line> = Vec::new();
19	
20	    // Active tabs (always shown at top)
21	    for (i, tab) in state.tabs.iter().enumerate() {
22	        let selected = i == state.active_tab;
23	        let style = if selected {
24	            Style::default()
25	                .fg(Color::Cyan)
26	                .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
27	        } else {
28	            Style::default().fg(Color::White)
29	        };
30	        let prefix = if selected { "● " } else { "  " };
31	        lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(format!("{}{}", prefix, tab.name), style)));
32	    }
33	
34	    // Session entries from JSONL (recent Claude sessions)
35	    if !state.session_entries.is_empty() {
36	        lines.push(Line::default());
37	        lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(
38	            "── Recent ──",
39	            Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray),
40	        )));
41	        let max_title_width = inner.width.saturating_sub(4) as usize;
42	        let visible_count = (inner.height as usize).saturating_sub(lines.len() + 1) / 2 + 1;
43	        for entry in state.session_entries.iter().take(visible_count.max(5)) {
44	            let title = if entry.title.len() > max_title_width && max_title_width > 1 {
45	                format!("{}…", &entry.title[..max_title_width.saturating_sub(1)])
46	            } else {
47	                entry.title.clone()
48	            };
49	            lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(
50	                format!("  {}", title),
51	                Style::default().fg(Color::Gray),
52	            )));
53	            lines.push(Line::default());
54	        }
55	    }
56	
57	    let para = Paragraph::new(lines);
58	    f.render_widget(para, inner);
59	}
60

1	use std::io::BufRead;
2	use crate::state::SessionEntry;
3	
4	pub fn load_claude_sessions(paths: &clui_config::Paths) -> Vec<SessionEntry> {
5	    let projects_dir = &paths.claude_projects_dir;
6	    let Ok(proj_entries) = std::fs::read_dir(projects_dir) else {
7	        return Vec::new();
8	    };
9	
10	    let mut sessions = Vec::new();
11	    for proj in proj_entries.filter_map(|e| e.ok()) {
12	        let Ok(proj_files) = std::fs::read_dir(proj.path()) else {
13	            continue;
14	        };
15	        for jsonl_file in proj_files
16	            .filter_map(|e| e.ok())
17	            .filter(|e| e.path().extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some("jsonl"))
18	        {
19	            let Ok(file) = std::fs::File::open(jsonl_file.path()) else {
20	                continue;
21	            };
22	            let reader = std::io::BufReader::new(file);
23	            let mut first_user_msg: Option<String> = None;
24	            for line in reader.lines().filter_map(|l| l.ok()) {
25	                if let Ok(val) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&line) {
26	                    if val["type"] == "user" {
27	                        let text = val["message"]["content"]
28	                            .as_str()
29	                            .map(|s| s.to_string())
30	                            .or_else(|| {
31	                                val["message"]["content"][0]["text"]
32	                                    .as_str()
33	                                    .map(|s| s.to_string())
34	                            });
35	                        if let Some(t) = text {
36	                            first_user_msg = Some(t);
37	                            break;
38	                        }
39	                    }
40	                }
41	            }
42	            if let Some(title) = first_user_msg {
43	                let path_str = jsonl_file.path().to_string_lossy().to_string();
44	                let modified = jsonl_file
45	                    .metadata()
46	                    .ok()
47	                    .and_then(|m| m.modified().ok())
48	                    .map(|t| {
49	                        let secs = t.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
50	                            .unwrap_or_default().as_secs();
51	                        format!("{}", secs)
52	                    })
53	                    .unwrap_or_default();
54	                sessions.push(SessionEntry { title, path: path_str, modified });
55	            }
56	        }
57	    }
58	    sessions.sort_by(|a, b| b.modified.cmp(&a.modified));
59	    sessions
60	}
61

6. **`router.rs`** — Added Sessions panel keyboard navigation (Up/Down with viewport tracking, Ctrl+D/B page jumps), mouse ScrollUp/ScrollDown for sessions, and Left-click tile selection. All handlers short-circuit with `return` to avoid conflicts.

**Build:** Success (3 pre-existing warnings, 0 errors). **Tests:** 21/21 passed.

to extract real content if any exists outside tags\n    let mut result = String::new();\n    let mut i = 0;\n    let chars: Vec<char> = trimmed.chars().collect();\n\n    while i < chars.len() {\n       while j < chars.len() && chars[j] != '>' && chars[j] != ' ' {\n                j += 1;\n            }\n            let tag_name: String = chars[tag_start..j].iter().collect();\n            // rest.find(&closing) {\n                i += end + closing.len();\n            } else {\n                // No closing tag — skip rest\n                break;\n            }\n        } else {\n }\n}\n\npub fn load_claude_sessions(paths: &clui_config::Paths) -> Vec<SessionEntry> {\n    let projects_dir = &paths.claude_projects_dir;\n    let Ok(proj_entries) = std::fs::read_dir(projects_dir) .as_str()\n                            .map(|s| s.to_string())\n                            .or_else(|| {\n                                val[\"message\"][\"content\"][0][\"text\"]\n sessions\n}\n"

below > 0 && above > 0 {\n        format!(\"↑ {} · {} ↓\", above, below)\n    } else if below > 0 {\n        format!(\"... {} more below\", below)\n    } else if above > 0 {\n        format!(\"... {} more above\", above)\n    } else {\n        String::new()\n    };\n\n    if !indicator.is_empty() {\n        f.render_widget(\n            Paragraph::new(Line::from(Span::styled(indicator, - 3].iter().collect::<String>()) }\n    else { chars[..max].iter().collect() }\n}\n\nfn format_ts(secs: u64) -> String {\n    use chrono::{Local, TimeZone};\n    match Local.timestamp_opt(secs as i64, 67	async fn run_loop(
68	    terminal: &mut Terminal<CrosstermBackend<io::Stdout>>,
69	    state: &mut AppState,
70	) -> Result<()> {
71	    let settings = clui_config::Settings::from_env();
72	    let (event_tx, mut event_rx) = mpsc::channel::<AppEvent>(256);
73	
74	    // Spawn agent for initial tab (uses claude CLI subprocess, no API key needed)
75	    {
76	        let tx = agent_task::spawn_agent(
77	            state.tabs[0].id.clone(),
78	            state.cwd.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
79	            settings.default_model.clone(),
80	            event_tx.clone(),
81	        );
82	        if let TabKind::Chat { agent_tx } = &mut state.tabs[0].kind {
83	            *agent_tx = Some(tx);
84	        }
85	    }
86	
87	    // Initial git refresh
88	    let _ = event_tx.send(AppEvent::GitRefresh).await;
89	
90	    // Spawn git watcher
91	    let etx_git = event_tx.clone();
92	    tokio::spawn(async move {
93	        loop {
94	            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(5)).await;
95	            let _ = etx_git.send(AppEvent::GitRefresh).await;
96	        }
97	    });
98	
99	    loop {
100	        terminal.draw(|f| ui::render(f, state))?;
101	
102	        // Drain async events
103	        while let Ok(evt) = event_rx.try_recv() {
104	            router::handle(state, evt);
105	        }
106	
107	        if crossterm_poll(Duration::from_millis(16))? {
108	            match crossterm_read()? {
109	                Event::Key(k) => router::handle(
110	                    state,
111	                    AppEvent::Key {
112	                        code: k.code,
113	                        modifiers: k.modifiers,
114	                    },
115	                ),
116	                Event::Mouse(m) => router::handle(
117	                    state,
118	                    AppEvent::Mouse {
119	                        kind: m.kind,
120	                        col: m.column,
121	                        row: m.row,
122	                        modifiers: m.modifiers,
123	                    },
124	                ),
125	                Event::Resize(c, r) => {
126	                    router::handle(state, AppEvent::Resize { cols: c, rows: r })
127	                }
128	                _ => {}
129	            }
130	        } else {
131	            router::handle(state, AppEvent::Tick);
132	        }
133	
134	        // Dispatch pending prompts to agent
135	        if let Some(tab) = state.active_tab_mut() {
136	            if let Some(prompt) = tab.pending_prompt.take() {
137	                if let TabKind::Chat {
138	                    agent_tx: Some(tx),
139	                } = &tab.kind
140	                {
141	                    let _ = tx
142	                        .send(agent_task::AgentCommand::SendPrompt { text: prompt })
143	                        .await;
144	                }
145	            }
146	        }
147	
148	        if state.should_quit {
149	            break;
150	        }
151	    }
152	    Ok(())
153	}

  "new_string": "    // Spawn git watcher\n    let etx_git = event_tx.clone();\n    tokio::spawn(async move {\n        loop {\n            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(5)).await;\n            let _ = etx_git.send(AppEvent::GitRefresh).await;\n        }\n    });\n\n    // Watch ~/.claude/projects/ for new/changed JSONL — refresh sessions instantly\n    {\n        use notify::{Config, RecommendedWatcher, RecursiveMode, Watcher};\n        use std::sync::mpsc as std_mpsc;\n\n        let projects_dir = clui_config::Paths::new().claude_projects_dir;\n        let etx_sessions = event_tx.clone();\n\n        // notify uses std channels; bridge to tokio via blocking spawn\n        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {\n            let (tx, rx) = std_mpsc::channel();\n            let mut watcher = match RecommendedWatcher::new(tx, Config::default()) {\n                Ok(w) => w,\n                Err(_) => return,\n            };\n            if watcher.watch(&projects_dir, RecursiveMode::Recursive).is_err() {\n                return;\n            }\n            // Debounce: don't send more than 1 refresh per 500ms\n            let mut last_sent = std::time::Instant::now()\n                .checked_sub(Duration::from_secs(1))\n                .unwrap_or(std::time::Instant::now());\n            loop {\n                match rx.recv() {\n                    Ok(Ok(event)) => {\n                        // Only care about .jsonl file changes\n                        let is_jsonl = event.paths.iter().any(|p| {\n                            p.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) == Some(\"jsonl\")\n                        });\n                        if is_jsonl && last_sent.elapsed() >= Duration::from_millis(500) {\n                            last_sent = std::time::Instant::now();\n                            let _ = etx_sessions.blocking_send(AppEvent::SessionsRefresh);\n                        }\n                    }\n                    Ok(Err(_)) | Err(_) => break,\n                }\n            }\n        });\n    }"

> AGENT

Done. Sessions now refresh **instantly** (within 500ms debounce) whenever a `.jsonl` file is created or modified in `~/.claude/projects/` — no restart needed.

How it works:
- `notify`'s `RecommendedWatcher` uses macOS `FSEvents` under the hood — zero polling, OS-native
- Runs in a `spawn_blocking` thread (notify is sync), bridges to tokio via `blocking_send`
- 500ms debounce to avoid hammering the JSONL parser when Claude writes many lines rapidly
- Sends `SessionsRefresh` → router reloads all sessions → panel re-renders next frame

{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/4thwithme/Documents/repo/clui/rust/crates/app/src/router.rs",
  "old_string": "        AppEvent::SessionsRefresh => {\n            let paths = clui_config::Paths::new();\n            state.session_entries = crate::session_loader::load_claude_sessions(&paths);\n        }",
  "new_string": "        AppEvent::SessionsRefresh => {\n            let paths = clui_config::Paths::new();\n            state.session_entries = crate::session_loader::load_claude_sessions(&paths);\n        }\n        AppEvent::FileTreeRefresh => {\n            // Remember which dirs are currently expanded\n            let expanded: std::collections::HashSet<String> = state.files.nodes.iter()\n                .filter(|n| n.is_dir && n.expanded)\n                .map(|n| n.path.clone())\n                .collect();\n            let pinned: std::collections::HashSet<String> = state.files.nodes.iter()\n                .filter(|n| n.pinned)\n                .map(|n| n.path.clone())\n                .collect();\n\n            // Reload root\n            let mut nodes = crate::filetree::load_children(&state.cwd, 0);\n\n            // Re-apply pinned flags and re-expand dirs\n            for n in &mut nodes { n.pinned = pinned.contains(&n.path); }\n            let mut i = 0;\n            while i < nodes.len() {\n                if nodes[i].is_dir && expanded.contains(&nodes[i].path) {\n                    nodes[i].expanded = true;\n                    let children = crate::filetree::load_children(\n                        std::path::Path::new(&nodes[i].path), nodes[i].depth + 1);\n                    // Apply pinned/expanded to children too\n                    let mut children: Vec<_> = children.into_iter().map(|mut c| {\n                        c.pinned = pinned.contains(&c.path);\n                        c\n                    }).collect();\n                    nodes.splice(i + 1..i + 1, children);\n                }\n                i += 1;\n            }\n\n            // Preserve selection by path if possible\n            let sel_path = state.files.nodes.get(state.files.selected).map(|n| n.path.clone());\n            state.files.nodes = nodes;\n            if let Some(path) = sel_path {\n                if let Some(idx) = state.files.nodes.iter().position(|n| n.path == path) {\n                    state.files.selected = idx;\n                } else {\n                    state.files.selected = state.files.selected.min(state.files.nodes.len().saturating_sub(1));\n                }\n            }\n        }"
}

}\n                                state.files.nodes.drain(idx + 1..end);\n                            }\n                        } else {\n                            // Open file viewer on single click\n                            let path = node.path.clone();\n                            let name = node.name.clone();\n                            let ext = node.extension.clone();\n                            if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(&path) {\n                                let id = format!(\"file-{}\", path);\n                                if !state.tabs.iter().any(|t| t.id == id) {\n                                    let mut tab = crate::state::TabState::new_chat(&id, &name);\n                                    tab.kind = crate::state::TabKind::FileViewer {\n                                        path, content, language: ext, scroll: 0 };\n                                    state.tabs.push(tab);\n                                }\n                                state.active_tab = state.tabs.iter().position(|t| t.id == id)\n                                    .unwrap_or(state.active_tab);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                    return;\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Check if click is inside sessions panel\n            let rect = state.sessions_panel_rect;"

Frame,\n};\nuse syntect::{\n    easy::HighlightLines,\n    highlighting::{Style as SyntectStyle, ThemeSet},\n    parsing::SyntaxSet,\n    util::LinesWithEndings,\n};\n\nstatic SYNTAX_SET: OnceLock<SyntaxSet> = OnceLock::new();\nstatic THEME_SET: OnceLock<ThemeSet> = OnceLock::new();\n\nfn syntax_set() -> &'static SyntaxSet {\n    SYNTAX_SET.get_or_init(SyntaxSet::load_defaults_newlines)\n}\n\nfn theme_set() -> &'static ThemeSet {\n    THEME_SET.get_or_init(ThemeSet::load_defaults)\n}\n\nfn to_ratatui_color(c: syntect::highlighting::Color) -> Color {\n    Color::Rgb(c.r, c.g, c.b)\n}\n\nfn to_ratatui_style(s: SyntectStyle) -> Style {\n    Style::default().fg(to_ratatui_color(s.foreground))\n}\n\n/// Highlight all lines in `content` and return them as ratatui Lines.\n/// We process from line 0 to maintain correct state for multi-line tokens.\nfn highlight_content(content: &str, extension: &str, num_width: usize) -> Vec<Line<'static>> {\n    let ss = syntax_set();\n    let ts = theme_set();\n\n    // Pick theme — \"base16-ocean.dark\" is a good dark terminal theme\n    let theme = ts.themes.get(\"base16-ocean.dark\")\n        .or_else(|| ts.themes.get(\"Solarized (dark)\"))\n        .or_else(|| ts.themes.values().next())\n        .unwrap();\n\n    // Find syntax by extension, fallback to plain text\n    let syntax = ss.find_syntax_by_extension(extension)\n        .or_else(|| ss.find_syntax_by_extension(&extension.to_lowercase()))\n        .unwrap_or_else(|| ss.find_syntax_plain_text());\n\n    let mut hl = HighlightLines::new(syntax, theme);\n    let mut result = Vec::new();\n\n    for (i, line) in LinesWithEndings::from(content).enumerate() {\n        let ranges = match hl.highlight_line(line, ss) {\n            Ok(r) => r,\n            Err(_) => {\n                result.push(Line::from(vec![\n                    Span::styled(\n                        format!(\"{:>width$} \", i + 1, width = num_width),\n                        Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray),\n                    ),\n                    Span::styled(line.trim_end_matches('\\n').to_string(), Style::default().fg(Color::White)),\n                ]));\n                continue;\n            }\n        };\n\n        let mut spans = vec![Span::styled(\n            format!(\"{:>width$} \", i + 1, width = num_width),\n            Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray),\n        )];\n\n        for (style, text) in ranges {\n            // Skip empty spans and trailing newlines\n            let clean = text.trim_end_matches('\\n');\n            if clean.is_empty() { continue; }\n            spans.push(Span::styled(clean.to_string(), to_ratatui_style(style)));\n        }\n\n        result.push(Line::from(spans));\n    }\n\n    result\n}\n\npub fn render_file_viewer(\n    f: &mut Frame,\n    path: &str,\n    content: &str,\n    scroll: usize,\n    area: Rect,\n) {\n    let filename = std::path::Path::new(path)\n        .file_name()\n        .and_then(|n| n.to_str())\n        .unwrap_or(path);\n    let extension = std::path::Path::new(path)\n        .extension()\n        .and_then(|e| e.to_str())\n        .unwrap_or(\"\");\n\n    let block = Block::default()\n        .borders(Borders::ALL)\n        .border_type(BorderType::Rounded)\n        .border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray))\n        .title(Span::styled(\n            format!(\" {} \", filename),\n            Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan),\n        ));\n    let inner = block.inner(area);\n    f.render_widget(block, area);\n\n    let total = content.lines().count();\n    let num_width = if total == 0 { 1 } else { total.to_string().len() };\n\n    // Highlight all lines (syntect is stateful — must start from line 0)\n    let all_lines = highlight_content(content, extension, num_width);\n\n    let visible: Vec<Line> = all_lines\n        .into_iter()\n        .skip(scroll)\n        .take(inner.height as usize)\n        .collect();\n\n    let para = Paragraph::new(visible);\n    f.render_widget(para, inner);\n}\n"
}

> AGENT

`source "$HOME/.cargo/env" && cargo run`

Syntax highlighting now works for all languages syntect supports (Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript, JSON, Markdown, YAML, Python, Go, etc.) using the **base16-ocean.dark** theme — a standard dark terminal theme with distinct colors per token type (keywords, strings, numbers, comments, etc.).

One note: highlighting is stateful (syntect must process from line 0 to correctly handle multi-line strings/comments), so it's slightly heavier on large files. On first open it'll feel instant; scrolling is re-highlighted each frame. If perf becomes an issue on huge files (10k+ lines) we can cache the highlighted lines by file path.

crate::state::AppState;\n\nfn file_icon_and_color(path: &str) -> (&'static str, Color) {\n    let ext = std::path::Path::new(path)\n        .extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    match ext {\n        \"ts\" | \"tsx\"             => (\"{}\", Color::Cyan),\n        \"js\" | \"jsx\" | \"mjs\"    => (\"{}\", Color::Yellow),\n        \"json\"                   => (\"{}\", Color::Green),\n        \"rs\"                     => (\"RS\", Color::Red),\n        \"md\"                     => (\"MD\", Color::White),\n        \"toml\" | \"yaml\" | \"yml\" => (\"≡\",  Color::Magenta),\n        \"css\" | \"scss\"           => (\"#\",  Color::Blue),\n        \"html\"                   => (\"<>\", Color::Red),\n        \"py\"                     => (\"py\", Color::Yellow),\n        \"go\"                     => (\"go\", Color::Cyan),\n        \"sh\" | \"bash\"            => (\"$\",  Color::Green),\n        _                        => (\"•\",  Color::Gray),\n    }\n}\n\nfn split_path(path: &str) -> (&str, &str) {\n    let p = std::path::Path::new(path);\n    let name   = p.file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str()).unwrap_or(path);\n    let parent = p.parent().and_then(|d| d.to_str()).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    (name, parent)\n}\n\nfn trunc(s: &str, max: usize) -> String {\n    let chars: Vec<char> = s.chars().collect();\n    if max == 0 { return String::new(); }\n    if chars.len() <= max { s.to_string() }\n    else if max > 1 { format!(\"{}…\", chars[..max-1].iter().collect::<String>()) }\n    else { chars[..1].iter().collect() }\n}\n\n/// Build one file row line with icons right-aligned.\n/// Layout (total = w chars):\n///   \" icon  name   <path padded>  [icons] status\"\n///   └─fixed─┘└fixed┘└──variable──┘└─fixed when sel─┘└──fixed──┘\nfn file_line(\n    w: usize,\n    icon_str: &str, icon_color: Color,\n    name: &str,\n    parent: &str,\n    actions: &[(&'static str, Color)], // shown when selected\n    status_ch: char, status_color: Color,\n    bg: Color,\n    selected: bool,\n) -> Line<'static> {\n    // Fixed widths\n    let icon_w   = icon_str.chars().count();\n    // name: up to half the line\n    let name_max = (w / 2).min(name.chars().count() + 2);\n    let name_s   = trunc(name, name_max);\n    let name_w   = name_s.chars().count();\n\n    // Right-fixed section: \" status\" (2) + optional icons (each 2: char + space)\n    let status_s = format!(\" {}\", status_ch);\n    let status_w = status_s.chars().count();\n    let icons_w: usize = if selected {\n        actions.len() * 2 + 1 // \"↑ ↓ ✕ ≠ \" = each icon + space, plus leading space\n    } else { 0 };\n\n    // Path fills remaining, padded with spaces to push right section to edge\n    let used       = icon_w + name_w + icons_w + status_w;\n    let path_area  = w.saturating_sub(used);\n    let path_raw   = if parent.is_empty() { String::new() } else { format!(\" {}\", parent) };\n    let path_trunc = trunc(&path_raw, path_area);\n    // Pad path to exactly path_area chars\n    let path_pad   = format!(\"{:<width$}\", path_trunc, width = path_area);\n\n    let mut spans: Vec<Span> = vec![\n        Span::styled(icon_str.to_string(),  Style::default().fg(icon_color).bg(bg)),\n        Span::styled(name_s,                Style::default().fg(Color::White).bg(bg).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),\n        Span::styled(path_pad,              Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray).bg(bg)),\n    ];\n\n    if selected {\n        spans.push(Span::styled(\" \".to_string(), Style::default().bg(bg)));\n        for (icon, color) in actions {\n            spans.push(Span::styled(icon.to_string(), Style::default().fg(*color).bg(bg)));\n            spans.push(Span::styled(\" \".to_string(), Style::default().bg(bg)));\n        }\n    }\n\n    spans.push(Span::styled(status_s, Style::default().fg(status_color).bg(bg).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)));\n    Line::from(spans)\n}\n\npub fn render_git(f: &mut Frame, state: &mut AppState, area: Rect) {\n    let block = Block::default()\n        .borders(Borders::ALL)\n        .border_type(BorderType::Rounded)\n        .border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray))\n        .title(Span::styled(\n            format!(\"  {} \", state.git.branch),\n            Style::default().fg(Color::Magenta).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),\n        ));\n    let inner = block.inner(area);\n    state.git_panel_rect = inner;\n    f.render_widget(block, area);\n\n    let w = inner.width as usize;\n    let mut lines: Vec<Line> = Vec::new();\n\n    // ── Staged Changes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    {\n        let count = state.git.staged.len();\n        let arrow = if state.git.staged_collapsed { \"▶\" } else { \"∨\" };\n        let right  = format!(\" [+all][-all]  {} \", count);\n        let left   = format!(\"{} Staged Changes\", arrow);\n        let left_w = w.saturating_sub(right.chars().count());\n\n        lines.push(Line::from(vec![\n            Span::styled(\n                format!(\"{:<w$}\", left, w = left_w),\n                Style::default().fg(Color::White).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),\n            ),\n            Span::styled(\" [+all][-all]\", Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)),\n            Span::styled(\n                format!(\"  {} \", count),\n                Style::default().fg(Color::Black).bg(Color::Cyan).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),\n            ),\n        ]));\n\n        if !state.git.staged_collapsed {\n            for (i, file) in state.git.staged.iter().enumerate() {\n                let selected = state.git.selected.as_ref()\n                    .map(|s| s.staged && s.index == i).unwrap_or(false);\n                let (name, parent)     = split_path(&file.path);\n                let (icon_s, icon_col) = file_icon_and_color(&file.path);\n                let icon_str           = format!(\" {} \", icon_s);\n                let status_col         = match file.status { 'A' => Color::Green, 'D' => Color::Red, _ => Color::Yellow };\n                let bg                 = if selected { Color::Rgb(40, 40, 60) } else { Color::Reset };\n                // staged: ↗ open  ↓ unstage  ≠ diff\n                let actions: &[(&str, Color)] = if selected {\n                    &[(\"↗\", Color::White), (\"↓\", Color::Yellow), (\"≠\", Color::Cyan)]\n                } else { &[] };\n                lines.push(file_line(w, &icon_str, icon_col, name, parent, actions, file.status, status_col, bg, selected));\n            }\n            if state.git.staged.is_empty() {\n                lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(\"  No staged changes\", Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray))));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    lines.push(Line::default());\n\n    // ── Changes (unstaged) ──────────────────────────────────────────────\n    {\n        let count = state.git.unstaged.len();\n        let arrow = if state.git.unstaged_collapsed { \"▶\" } else { \"∨\" };\n        let right  = format!(\" [+all][-all]  {} \", count);\n        let left   = format!(\"{} Changes\", arrow);\n        let left_w = w.saturating_sub(right.chars().count());\n\n        lines.push(Line::from(vec![\n            Span::styled(\n                format!(\"{:<w$}\", left, w = left_w),\n                Style::default().fg(Color::White).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),\n            ),\n            Span::styled(\" [+all][-all]\", Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)),\n            Span::styled(\n                format!(\"  {} \", count),\n                Style::default().fg(Color::Black).bg(Color::Yellow).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),\n            ),\n        ]));\n\n        if !state.git.unstaged_collapsed {\n            for (i, file) in state.git.unstaged.iter().enumerate() {\n                let selected = state.git.selected.as_ref()\n                    .map(|s| !s.staged && s.index == i).unwrap_or(false);\n                let (name, parent)     = split_path(&file.path);\n                let (icon_s, icon_col) = file_icon_and_color(&file.path);\n                let icon_str           = format!(\" {} \", icon_s);\n                let status_col         = match file.status {\n                    'A' | '?' => Color::Green, 'D' => Color::Red, _ => Color::Yellow,\n                };\n                let bg = if selected { Color::Rgb(40, 40, 60) } else { Color::Reset };\n                // unstaged: ↗ open  ↑ stage  ✕ discard  ≠ diff\n                let actions: &[(&str, Color)] = if selected {\n                    &[(\"↗\", Color::White), (\"↑\", Color::Green), (\"✕\", Color::Red), (\"≠\", Color::Cyan)]\n                } else { &[] };\n                lines.push(file_line(w, &icon_str, icon_col, name, parent, actions, file.status, status_col, bg, selected));\n            }\n            if state.git.unstaged.is_empty() {\n                lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(\"  No changes\", Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray))));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    lines.push(Line::default());\n    lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(\n        \"↑↓ nav · Alt+s stage · Alt+u unstage · Alt+d discard\",\n        Style::default().fg(Color::Rgb(55, 55, 55)),\n    )));\n\n    f.render_widget(Paragraph::new(lines), inner);\n}\n"

}\n    if chars.len() <= max { return s.to_string(); }\n    if max > 1 { format!(\"{}…\", chars[..max-1].iter().collect::<String>()) }\n    else { chars[..1].iter().collect() }\n}\n\n/// One button: `[ label ]` — returns (rendered_string, visual_width, tooltip, color)\nstruct Btn {\n    label: &'static str,\n    color: Color,\n    tooltip: &'static str,\n}\n\nimpl Btn {\n    /// Visual width: 2 brackets + 2 spaces + label = label.len() + 4\n    fn width(&self) -> usize { self.label.len() + 4 }\n    fn render(&self) -> String { format!(\"[ {} ]\", self.label) }\n}\n\nconst STAGED_BTNS: &[Btn] = &[\n    Btn { label: \"open\",    color: Color::White,  tooltip: \"open  — open file in viewer\" },\n    Btn { label: \"unstage\", color: Color::Yellow, tooltip: \"unstage  — remove from staged\" },\n    Btn { label: \"diff\",    color: Color::Cyan,   tooltip: \"diff  — view staged diff\" },\n];\nconst UNSTAGED_BTNS: &[Btn] = &[\n    Btn { label: \"open\",    color: Color::White,  tooltip: \"open  — open file in viewer\" },\n    Btn { label: \"stage\",   color: Color::Green,  tooltip: \"stage  — add to staged changes\" },\n    Btn { label: \"discard\", color: Color::Red,    tooltip: \"discard  — revert to last commit\" },\n    Btn { label: \"diff\",    color: Color::Cyan,   tooltip: \"diff  — view unstaged diff\" },\n];\n\n/// Total width of all buttons + 1 space between each\nfn total_btns_width(btns: &[Btn]) -> usize {\n    btns.iter().map(|b| b.width()).sum::<usize>() + btns.len().saturating_sub(1)\n}\n\n/// Build a file row line. Buttons are right-aligned before the status char.\nfn file_line(\n    w: usize,\n    icon_str: &str, icon_color: Color,\n    name: &str, parent: &str,\n    btns: &[Btn], selected: bool,\n    status_ch: char, status_color: Color,\n    bg: Color,\n) -> Line<'static> {\n    let icon_w  = icon_str.chars().count();\n    let name_s  = trunc(name, w / 2);\n    let name_w  = name_s.chars().count();\n    let status_s = format!(\" {}\", status_ch);\n    let status_w = status_s.chars().count();\n    let btns_w  = if selected { total_btns_width(btns) + 1 } else { 0 }; // +1 leading space\n\n    let path_area = w.saturating_sub(icon_w + name_w + btns_w + status_w);\n    let path_raw  = if parent.is_empty() { String::new() } else { format!(\" {}\", parent) };\n    let path_trunc = trunc(&path_raw, path_area);\n    let path_pad  = format!(\"{:<width$}\", path_trunc, width = path_area);\n\n    let mut spans: Vec<Span> = vec![\n        Span::styled(icon_str.to_string(), Style::default().fg(icon_color).bg(bg)),\n        Span::styled(name_s,              Style::default().fg(Color::White).bg(bg).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),\n        Span::styled(path_pad,            Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray).bg(bg)),\n    ];\n\n    if selected {\n        spans.push(Span::styled(\" \".to_string(), Style::default().bg(bg)));\n        for (i, btn) in btns.iter().enumerate() {\n            if i > 0 {\n                spans.push(Span::styled(\" \".to_string(), Style::default().bg(bg)));\n            }\n            spans.push(Span::styled(\n                \"[\".to_string(),\n                Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray).bg(bg),\n            ));\n            spans.push(Span::styled(\n                format!(\" {} \", btn.label),\n                Style::default().fg(btn.color).bg(bg).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),\n            ));\n            spans.push(Span::styled(\n                \"]\".to_string(),\n                Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray).bg(bg),\n            ));\n        }\n    }\n\n    spans.push(Span::styled(status_s, Style::default().fg(status_color).bg(bg).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)));\n    Line::from(spans)\n}\n\n/// Detect which button (if any) is under col on a selected file row.\n/// Returns tooltip string or None.\npub fn hover_tooltip(state: &AppState, col: u16, row: u16) -> Option<String> {\n    let r = state.git_panel_rect;\n    if col < r.x || col >= r.x + r.width { return None; }\n    if row < r.y || row >= r.y + r.height { return None; }\n\n    let rel_row = (row - r.y) as usize;\n    let rel_col = (col - r.x) as usize;\n    let w = r.width as usize;\n\n    let staged_count  = state.git.staged.len();\n    let staged_rows   = if state.git.staged_collapsed { 0 } else if staged_count == 0 { 1 } else { staged_count };\n    let changes_header = 1 + staged_rows + 1;\n    let unstaged_count = state.git.unstaged.len();\n\n    let check_btns = |btns: &[Btn], file_row: usize| -> Option<String> {\n        if rel_row != file_row { return None; }\n        let btns_w = total_btns_width(btns) + 1;\n        let status_w = 2usize;\n        let btns_start = w.saturating_sub(btns_w + status_w);\n        if rel_col < btns_start { return None; }\n        let mut col_off = rel_col - btns_start - 1; // -1 for leading space\n        for btn in btns {\n            if col_off < btn.width() {\n                return Some(btn.tooltip.to_string());\n            }\n            col_off = col_off.saturating_sub(btn.width() + 1); // +1 for space between\n        }\n        None\n    };\n\n    if let Some(sel) = &state.git.selected {\n        if sel.staged && !state.git.staged_collapsed && staged_count > 0 {\n            return check_btns(STAGED_BTNS, 1 + sel.index);\n        }\n        if !sel.staged && !state.git.unstaged_collapsed && unstaged_count > 0 {\n            return check_btns(UNSTAGED_BTNS, changes_header + 1 + sel.index);\n        }\n    }\n    None\n}\n\npub fn render_git(f: &mut Frame, state: &mut AppState, area: Rect) {\n    let block = Block::default()\n        .borders(Borders::ALL)\n        .border_type(BorderType::Rounded)\n        .border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray))\n        .title(Span::styled(\n            format!(\"  {} \", state.git.branch),\n            Style::default().fg(Color::Magenta).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),\n        ));\n    let inner = block.inner(area);\n    state.git_panel_rect = inner;\n    f.render_widget(block, area);\n\n    let w = inner.width as usize;\n    let mut lines: Vec<Line> = Vec::new();\n\n    // ── Staged Changes ──────────────────────────────\n    {\n        let count  = state.git.staged.len();\n        let arrow  = if state.git.staged_collapsed { \"▶\" } else { \"∨\" };\n        let right  = format!(\" [+all][-all]  {} \", count);\n        let left   = format!(\"{} Staged Changes\", arrow);\n        let left_w = w.saturating_sub(right.chars().count());\n        lines.push(Line::from(vec![\n            Span::styled(format!(\"{:<w$}\", left, w=left_w), Style::default().fg(Color::White).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),\n            Span::styled(\" [+all][-all]\", Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)),\n            Span::styled(format!(\"  {} \", count), Style::default().fg(Color::Black).bg(Color::Cyan).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),\n        ]));\n        if !state.git.staged_collapsed {\n            for (i, file) in state.git.staged.iter().enumerate() {\n                let sel = state.git.selected.as_ref().map(|s| s.staged && s.index == i).unwrap_or(false);\n                let (name, parent) = split_path(&file.path);\n                let (icon_s, icon_col) = file_icon_and_color(&file.path);\n                let icon_str = format!(\" {} \", icon_s);\n                let status_col = match file.status { 'A' => Color::Green, 'D' => Color::Red, _ => Color::Yellow };\n                let bg = if sel { Color::Rgb(40,40,60) } else { Color::Reset };\n                lines.push(file_line(w, &icon_str, icon_col, name, parent, STAGED_BTNS, sel, file.status, status_col, bg));\n            }\n            if state.git.staged.is_empty() {\n                lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(\"  No staged changes\", Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray))));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    lines.push(Line::default());\n\n    // ── Changes (unstaged) ──────────────────────────\n    {\n        let count  = state.git.unstaged.len();\n        let arrow  = if state.git.unstaged_collapsed { \"▶\" } else { \"∨\" };\n        let right  = format!(\" [+all][-all]  {} \", count);\n        let left   = format!(\"{} Changes\", arrow);\n        let left_w = w.saturating_sub(right.chars().count());\n        lines.push(Line::from(vec![\n            Span::styled(format!(\"{:<w$}\", left, w=left_w), Style::default().fg(Color::White).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),\n            Span::styled(\" [+all][-all]\", Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)),\n            Span::styled(format!(\"  {} \", count), Style::default().fg(Color::Black).bg(Color::Yellow).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),\n        ]));\n        if !state.git.unstaged_collapsed {\n            for (i, file) in state.git.unstaged.iter().enumerate() {\n                let sel = state.git.selected.as_ref().map(|s| !s.staged && s.index == i).unwrap_or(false);\n                let (name, parent) = split_path(&file.path);\n                let (icon_s, icon_col) = file_icon_and_color(&file.path);\n                let icon_str = format!(\" {} \", icon_s);\n                let status_col = match file.status { 'A'|'?' => Color::Green, 'D' => Color::Red, _ => Color::Yellow };\n                let bg = if sel { Color::Rgb(40,40,60) } else { Color::Reset };\n                lines.push(file_line(w, &icon_str, icon_col, name, parent, UNSTAGED_BTNS, sel, file.status, status_col, bg));\n            }\n            if state.git.unstaged.is_empty() {\n                lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(\"  No changes\", Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray))));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Tooltip / hint at bottom\n    let tooltip = state.git_tooltip.clone();\n    let bottom_line = if let Some(tip) = tooltip {\n        Line::from(Span::styled(tip, Style::default().fg(Color::White).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)))\n    } else {\n        Line::from(Span::styled(\n            \"↑↓ nav · Alt+s/u/d · Enter diff\",\n            Style::default().fg(Color::Rgb(55,55,55)),\n        ))\n    };\n\n    // Fill to bottom, then append tooltip\n    let content_lines = lines.len();\n    let available = inner.height as usize;\n    if content_lines < available.saturating_sub(1) {\n        for _ in content_lines..available.saturating_sub(1) {\n            lines.push(Line::default());\n        }\n    }\n    lines.push(bottom_line);\n\n    f.render_widget(Paragraph::new(lines), inner);\n}\n"

Color::Cyan,   \"diff\"),\n];\n\n/// Width of icons area when selected: \" icon icon icon\" — 1 space + (icon + space) * N\nfn icons_w(icons: &[(&str, Color, &str)]) -> usize {\n    1 + icons.len() * 2  // leading space + each \"X \"\n}\n\nfn file_line(\n    w: usize,\n    icon_str: &str, icon_color: Color,\n    name: &str, parent: &str,\n    action_icons: &[(&str, Color, &str)],\n    selected: bool,\n    status_ch: char, status_color: Color,\n    bg: Color,\n) -> Line<'static> {\n    let icon_w   = icon_str.chars().count();\n    let name_s   = trunc(name, w / 2);\n    let name_w   = name_s.chars().count();\n    let status_s = format!(\" {}\", status_ch);\n    let status_w = 2usize;\n    let act_w    = if selected { icons_w(action_icons) } else { 0 };\n\n    let path_area  = w.saturating_sub(icon_w + name_w + act_w + status_w);\n    let path_raw   = if parent.is_empty() { String::new() } else { format!(\" {}\", parent) };\n    let path_trunc = trunc(&path_raw, path_area);\n    let path_pad   = format!(\"{:<width$}\", path_trunc, width = path_area);\n\n    let mut spans: Vec<Span> = vec![\n        Span::styled(icon_str.to_string(), Style::default().fg(icon_color).bg(bg)),\n        Span::styled(name_s,              Style::default().fg(Color::White).bg(bg).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),\n        Span::styled(path_pad,            Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray).bg(bg)),\n    ];\n\n    if selected {\n        spans.push(Span::styled(\" \".to_string(), Style::default().bg(bg)));\n        for (icon, color, _) in action_icons {\n            spans.push(Span::styled(icon.to_string(), Style::default().fg(*color).bg(bg).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)));\n            spans.push(Span::styled(\" \".to_string(), Style::default().bg(bg)));\n        }\n    }\n\n    spans.push(Span::styled(status_s, Style::default().fg(status_color).bg(bg).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)));\n    Line::from(spans)\n}\n\n/// Check if mouse is over a specific icon; return (screen_col, screen_row, label) if so.\npub fn hover_tooltip(state: &AppState, col: u16, row: u16) -> Option<(u16, u16, String)> {\n    let r = state.git_panel_rect;\n    if col < r.x || col >= r.x + r.width || row < r.y || row >= r.y + r.height {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    let rel_col  = (col - r.x) as usize;\n    let rel_row  = (row - r.y) as usize;\n    let w        = r.width as usize;\n\n    let staged_count  = state.git.staged.len();\n    let staged_rows   = if state.git.staged_collapsed { 0 } else if staged_count == 0 { 1 } else { staged_count };\n    let changes_row   = 1 + staged_rows + 1;\n\n    let check = |icons: &[(&str, Color, &str)], file_row: usize| -> Option<(u16, u16, String)> {\n        if rel_row != file_row { return None; }\n        let act_w  = icons_w(icons);\n        let status_w = 2usize;\n        // icons start after path ends: w - act_w - status_w\n        let icons_start = w.saturating_sub(act_w + status_w);\n        if rel_col < icons_start + 1 { return None; } // +1 for leading space\n        let off = rel_col - (icons_start + 1);\n        // Each icon occupies 2 chars (icon + space), so icon index = off / 2\n        let idx = off / 2;\n        if idx < icons.len() {\n            let label = icons[idx].2.to_string();\n            return Some((col, row, label));\n        }\n        None\n    };\n\n    if let Some(sel) = &state.git.selected {\n        if sel.staged && !state.git.staged_collapsed && staged_count > 0 {\n            return check(STAGED_ICONS, 1 + sel.index);\n        }\n        if !sel.staged && !state.git.unstaged_collapsed {\n            let unstaged_count = state.git.unstaged.len();\n            if unstaged_count > 0 {\n                return check(UNSTAGED_ICONS, changes_row + 1 + sel.index);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    None\n}\n\npub fn render_git(f: &mut Frame, state: &mut AppState, area: Rect) {\n    let block = Block::default()\n        .borders(Borders::ALL)\n        .border_type(BorderType::Rounded)\n        .border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray))\n        .title(Span::styled(\n            format!(\"  {} \", state.git.branch),\n            Style::default().fg(Color::Magenta).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),\n        ));\n    let inner = block.inner(area);\n    state.git_panel_rect = inner;\n    f.render_widget(block, area);\n\n    let w = inner.width as usize;\n    let mut lines: Vec<Line> = Vec::new();\n\n    // ── Staged Changes ────────────────────────────────────\n    {\n        let count  = state.git.staged.len();\n        let arrow  = if state.git.staged_collapsed { \"▶\" } else { \"∨\" };\n        let right  = format!(\" [+all][-all]  {} \", count);\n        let left   = format!(\"{} Staged Changes\", arrow);\n        let left_w = w.saturating_sub(right.chars().count());\n        lines.push(Line::from(vec![\n            Span::styled(format!(\"{:<w$}\", left, w=left_w), Style::default().fg(Color::White).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),\n            Span::styled(\" [+all][-all]\", Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)),\n            Span::styled(format!(\"  {} \", count), Style::default().fg(Color::Black).bg(Color::Cyan).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),\n        ]));\n        if !state.git.staged_collapsed {\n            for (i, file) in state.git.staged.iter().enumerate() {\n                let sel = state.git.selected.as_ref().map(|s| s.staged && s.index == i).unwrap_or(false);\n                let (name, parent)     = split_path(&file.path);\n                let (icon_s, icon_col) = file_icon_and_color(&file.path);\n                let icon_str           = format!(\" {} \", icon_s);\n                let status_col         = match file.status { 'A' => Color::Green, 'D' => Color::Red, _ => Color::Yellow };\n                let bg                 = if sel { Color::Rgb(40,40,60) } else { Color::Reset };\n                lines.push(file_line(w, &icon_str, icon_col, name, parent, STAGED_ICONS, sel, file.status, status_col, bg));\n            }\n            if state.git.staged.is_empty() {\n                lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(\"  No staged changes\", Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray))));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    lines.push(Line::default());\n\n    // ── Changes (unstaged) ────────────────────────────────\n    {\n        let count  = state.git.unstaged.len();\n        let arrow  = if state.git.unstaged_collapsed { \"▶\" } else { \"∨\" };\n        let right  = format!(\" [+all][-all]  {} \", count);\n        let left   = format!(\"{} Changes\", arrow);\n        let left_w = w.saturating_sub(right.chars().count());\n        lines.push(Line::from(vec![\n            Span::styled(format!(\"{:<w$}\", left, w=left_w), Style::default().fg(Color::White).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),\n            Span::styled(\" [+all][-all]\", Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)),\n            Span::styled(format!(\"  {} \", count), Style::default().fg(Color::Black).bg(Color::Yellow).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),\n        ]));\n        if !state.git.unstaged_collapsed {\n            for (i, file) in state.git.unstaged.iter().enumerate() {\n                let sel = state.git.selected.as_ref().map(|s| !s.staged && s.index == i).unwrap_or(false);\n                let (name, parent)     = split_path(&file.path);\n                let (icon_s, icon_col) = file_icon_and_color(&file.path);\n                let icon_str           = format!(\" {} \", icon_s);\n                let status_col         = match file.status { 'A'|'?' => Color::Green, 'D' => Color::Red, _ => Color::Yellow };\n                let bg                 = if sel { Color::Rgb(40,40,60) } else { Color::Reset };\n                lines.push(file_line(w, &icon_str, icon_col, name, parent, UNSTAGED_ICONS, sel, file.status, status_col, bg));\n            }\n            if state.git.unstaged.is_empty() {\n                lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(\"  No changes\", Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray))));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    lines.push(Line::default());\n    lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(\n        \"↑↓ · Alt+s/u/d · Enter diff\",\n        Style::default().fg(Color::Rgb(55,55,55)),\n    )));\n\n    f.render_widget(Paragraph::new(lines), inner);\n\n    // ── Floating tooltip ─────────────────────────────────\n    if let Some((tip_col, tip_row, ref label)) = state.git_tooltip.clone() {\n        let text  = format!(\" {} \", label);\n        let tip_w = text.chars().count() as u16 + 2; // borders\n        let tip_h = 3u16;\n\n        // Position: just above the icon, clamped to screen\n        let x = tip_col.saturating_sub(tip_w / 2);\n        let y = if tip_row >= tip_h { tip_row - tip_h } else { tip_row + 1 };\n\n        let tip_rect = Rect::new(x, y, tip_w, tip_h);\n\n        let tip_block = Block::default()\n            .borders(Borders::ALL)\n            .border_type(BorderType::Rounded)\n            .border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::White));\n\n        let tip_inner = tip_block.inner(tip_rect);\n        f.render_widget(Clear, tip_rect);\n        f.render_widget(tip_block, tip_rect);\n        f.render_widget(\n            Paragraph::new(text).style(Style::default().fg(Color::White).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),\n            tip_inner,\n        );\n    }\n}\n"

> AGENT

`source "$HOME/.cargo/env" && cargo run`

Icon clicks now work:

**Staged file** (`↗ ↓ ≠`):
- `↗` → opens file in viewer tab
- `↓` → unstages, shows notification, refreshes
- `≠` → opens diff tab

**Unstaged file** (`↗ ↑ ✕ ≠`):
- `↗` → opens file in viewer tab
- `↑` → stages file, notification, refresh
- `✕` → shows confirm dialog "Discard changes?"
- `≠` → opens diff tab

Clicking on the filename/path area still selects the file and opens the diff (existing behavior).

46	    let right_border_color = if state.layout.drag.as_ref().map(|d| d.target == DragTarget::RightBorder).unwrap_or(false) {

48	    } else if state.hover_right_border {
49	        Color::Yellow
50	    } else if right_focused {
51	        Color::Cyan
52	    } else {
53	        Color::DarkGray
54	    };
55	
56	    layout::render_tab_bar(f, state, cols.tab_bar);

Here is a comprehensive summary of what the Claude Agent SDK offers, based on the documentation:

---

## Claude Agent SDK — Key Findings

### What It Is

The Claude Code SDK was recently renamed to the **Claude Agent SDK**. It exposes the same agent loop, tools, and context management that power Claude Code itself — but as a programmable library. The core abstraction is a single `query()` function that returns an async generator (stream) of messages as the agent thinks, calls tools, and produces output.

### Languages Supported

**Python and TypeScript only.** There is no Rust SDK, no Go SDK, and no other language bindings. No indication any are planned.

- TypeScript: `npm install @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk` (was `@anthropic-ai/claude-code`)
- Python: `pip install claude-agent-sdk` (was `claude-code-sdk`)

Both packages are authored by Anthropic and hosted on npm/PyPI. The SDK also supports routing through Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Azure AI Foundry via environment variables.

### Streaming Support

Streaming is the default and recommended mode. `query()` returns an `AsyncGenerator` that yields message objects in real time as Claude works:

- `SystemMessage` (type: `"system"`) — init event with `session_id`
- `AssistantMessage` (type: `"assistant"`) — Claude's text and tool calls
- `ToolResultMessage` — results of executed tools
- `ResultMessage` (type: `"result"`) — final summary with cost, turn count, `session_id`

There is also a **single-message / one-shot mode** where you just await the final result, useful for stateless environments (lambdas, CI). In single-mode you lose image attachment support, dynamic message queueing, and real-time interruption.

A **TypeScript V2 preview** adds `createSession()` with `send()` / `stream()` patterns (closer to Python's `ClaudeSDKClient`), but it is unstable.

### Session / Conversation Management

Sessions are first-class. The SDK persists conversation history to disk at `~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/<session-id>.jsonl`.

Three resumption modes:
- **`continue: true`** — resumes the most recent session in the cwd, no ID needed
- **`resume: <sessionId>`** — resumes a specific past session by ID
- **`forkSession: true`** — creates a new session branching from an existing one (original untouched)

Python also has `ClaudeSDKClient` (async context manager) that tracks session state internally across multiple `client.query()` calls. Sessions persist the **conversation**, not filesystem changes (for that, there's a separate file checkpointing feature).

`listSessions()` / `getSessionMessages()` / `renameSession()` / `tagSession()` are available in both languages for building custom session UIs — directly relevant to clui's session sidebar.

### Built-in Tools

The SDK ships with the same tools Claude Code uses, all executed autonomously by the agent:

| Tool | Action |
|------|--------|
| Read, Write, Edit | File I/O |
| Bash | Shell commands, git |
| Glob, Grep | File/content search |
| WebSearch, WebFetch | Web access |
| AskUserQuestion | Clarifying questions with multiple choice |
| Agent | Spawn subagents |
| Skill | Invoke skills from `.claude/skills/` |

Tools are controlled via `allowedTools` (whitelist) plus `permissionMode` (`acceptEdits`, `dontAsk`, `bypassPermissions`, `auto`, `default`).

### Skills / `/skill` / `@file` Support

Skills work in the SDK — they are filesystem artifacts (`SKILL.md` files in `.claude/skills/`). To enable them:
1. Add `"Skill"` to `allowedTools`
2. Set `settingSources: ["user", "project"]` — **this is opt-in; no filesystem config is loaded by default as of v0.1.0**

The SDK does not support programmatic skill registration — skills must be filesystem files. `@file` and slash commands work the same way (opt-in via `settingSources`).

### Hooks / Lifecycle

`PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `Stop`, `SessionStart`, `SessionEnd`, `UserPromptSubmit` hooks accept async callback functions. Hooks can log, validate, block, or transform tool calls at runtime — useful for audit trails, custom permission logic, or rate limiting.

### MCP Support

MCP servers can be passed as config (command + args) in `mcpServers` / `mcp_servers`. Custom in-process MCP tools can be defined with `tool()` + `createSdkMcpServer()` (TypeScript) using Zod schemas.

### Subagents

Pass `agents: { "name": { description, prompt, tools } }` and include `"Agent"` in `allowedTools`. The main agent can delegate subtasks to named subagents. Messages from subagents include `parent_tool_use_id` for tracking.

---

## SDK vs. `claude --print --output-format stream-json`

| Concern | `claude` subprocess (stream-json) | Claude Agent SDK |
|---|---|---|
| **Overhead** | Process fork + IPC marshaling | In-process; no fork |
| **Streaming** | NDJSON over stdout, parse manually | Native async generator, typed message objects |
| **Session mgmt** | `--resume <id>` flag, no fork | `resume`, `continue`, `forkSession` options; `listSessions()`, `getSessionMessages()` |
| **Hooks** | External hooks in `settings.json` | In-process callbacks with full access to app state |
| **Custom tools** | Not possible | MCP servers, in-process tool definitions with Zod |
| **Skills** | Loaded automatically from filesystem | Opt-in via `settingSources` + `allowedTools: ["Skill"]` |
| **Permission control** | Interactive prompts or `--permission-mode` | Per-query `permissionMode` + `allowedTools` + `canUseTool` callback |
| **Subagents** | Not directly controllable | `agents` option with custom system prompts and tool restrictions |
| **Cross-host sessions** | Session files must be copied manually | Same limitation — JSONL files are local |
| **Image input** | Not supported | Yes, in streaming input mode |
| **Type safety** | You parse raw JSON | Fully typed message union types |
| **Auth providers** | Inherits env vars | Bedrock, Vertex, Azure via env vars |

**Bottom line for clui:** The SDK is the correct architectural choice over subprocess + stream-json. It eliminates process-fork overhead, provides typed session management APIs that map directly to what clui's session sidebar and worker IPC already does, and gives in-process hook/permission control. The main constraint is **TypeScript/Python only** — no Rust SDK exists, which is relevant to the Rust/Ratatui rewrite decision noted in memory.

> AGENT

**No Rust SDK.** TypeScript and Python only.

Our current Rust approach (`claude --print --output-format stream-json`) is essentially what the SDK does internally — just with subprocess overhead and manual JSON parsing.

Key things the SDK gives that we're missing:

| Feature | SDK | Our subprocess |
|---|---|---|
| `listSessions()` / `getSessionMessages()` | ✅ typed | ❌ we parse JSONL manually |
| `resume` / `continue` / `forkSession` | ✅ | ✅ `--resume` flag |
| `@file`, `/skill` in prompts | ✅ native | ✅ CLI processes them |
| Typed streaming messages | ✅ | ❌ manual JSON parse |
| In-process hooks | ✅ | ❌ |
| Tool use visibility | ✅ | ❌ we only get text chunks |

**Two real options for the Rust rewrite:**

**A) Keep subprocess (current)** — works fine for chat. We miss tool-use events (seeing which files Claude reads/writes as it works). Add UI autocomplete for `@`/`/`/`#` on top.

**B) Bridge to TS prototype worker** — the `prototype/` already uses the real SDK correctly. Rust shell spawns the TS worker processes (our original Option A design), gets typed events via IPC including tool use, permission hooks, everything. Requires Node at runtime.

The prototype's worker is already battle-tested. Want to switch to Option B and wire the Rust shell back to the TS SDK workers via Unix socket IPC? That gives you full tool-use visibility, proper `@file` handling, and the session APIs without writing a Rust SDK wrapper.

  "new_string": "/// Compute (line_idx, col_idx) from a mouse click at (col, row) inside the input inner area.\npub fn cursor_from_mouse(state: &InputState, area: ratatui::layout::Rect, col: u16, row: u16) -> (usize, usize) {\n    // Inner area starts 1 col in (for border), and first col is \">\" prefix (2 chars)\n    let prefix_w = 2usize; // \"> \"\n    let li = (row.saturating_sub(area.y)) as usize;\n    let li = li.min(state.lines.len().saturating_sub(1));\n    let rel_col = (col.saturating_sub(area.x)) as usize;\n    let ci = rel_col.saturating_sub(prefix_w);\n    let line_len = state.lines[li].chars().count();\n    (li, ci.min(line_len))\n}\n\npub fn render_input(\n    f: &mut Frame,\n    state: &InputState,\n    area: ratatui::layout::Rect,\n    focused: bool,\n    input_rect_out: &mut ratatui::layout::Rect,\n) {\n    let border_style = if focused {\n        Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan)\n    } else {\n        Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)\n    };\n\n    let block = Block::default()\n        .borders(Borders::ALL)\n        .border_type(BorderType::Rounded)\n        .border_style(border_style);\n\n    let inner = block.inner(area);\n    *input_rect_out = inner; // store for mouse click mapping\n    f.render_widget(block, area);\n\n    let text_lines: Vec<Line> = state\n        .lines\n        .iter()\n        .enumerate()\n        .map(|(li, line)| {\n            let mut spans = Vec::new();\n\n            // \"> \" prefix on first line, \"  \" on subsequent\n            let prefix = if li == 0 { \"> \" } else { \"  \" };\n            spans.push(Span::styled(prefix, Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)));\n\n            let chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();\n            for (ci, &ch) in chars.iter().enumerate() {\n                let is_cursor = li == state.cursor_line && ci == state.cursor_col;\n                let in_sel = in_selection(state, li, ci);\n                let style = if is_cursor || in_sel {\n                    Style::default().bg(Color::White).fg(Color::Black)\n                } else {\n                    Style::default().fg(Color::White)\n                };\n                spans.push(Span::styled(ch.to_string(), style));\n            }\n            // Cursor at end of line\n            if li == state.cursor_line && state.cursor_col == chars.len() {\n                spans.push(Span::styled(\" \", Style::default().bg(Color::White).fg(Color::Black)));\n            }\n            Line::from(spans)\n        })\n        .collect();\n\n    let para = Paragraph::new(text_lines);\n    f.render_widget(para, inner);\n}\n\nfn in_selection(state: &InputState, li: usize, ci: usize) -> bool {\n    let Some(sel) = &state.selection else { return false };\n    let (sl, sc, el, ec) = if (sel.start_line, sel.start_col) < (sel.end_line, sel.end_col) {\n        (sel.start_line, sel.start_col, sel.end_line, sel.end_col)\n    } else {\n        (sel.end_line, sel.end_col, sel.start_line, sel.start_col)\n    };\n    if li < sl || li > el { false }\n    else if li == sl && li == el { ci >= sc && ci < ec }\n    else if li == sl { ci >= sc }\n    else if li == el { ci < ec }\n    else { true }\n}"
}

  "new_string": "/// Set anchor if not set, move cursor, update selection.\nfn extend_selection(s: &mut InputState, move_fn: fn(&mut InputState)) {\n    if s.selection_anchor.is_none() {\n        s.selection_anchor = Some((s.cursor_line, s.cursor_col));\n    }\n    // Move cursor (move_fn clears selection, so we restore anchor after)\n    let anchor = s.selection_anchor;\n    move_fn(s);\n    s.selection_anchor = anchor;\n    // Update selection based on anchor vs cursor\n    if let Some((al, ac)) = s.selection_anchor {\n        let cursor = (s.cursor_line, s.cursor_col);\n        if (al, ac) == cursor {\n            s.selection = None;\n            s.selection_anchor = None;\n        } else {\n            let (start, end) = if (al, ac) <= cursor { ((al, ac), cursor) } else { (cursor, (al, ac)) };\n            s.selection = Some(crate::state::Selection {\n                start_line: start.0, start_col: start.1,\n                end_line: end.0, end_col: end.1,\n            });\n        }\n    }\n}\n\npub fn input_select_left(s: &mut InputState)  { extend_selection(s, input_move_left); }\npub fn input_select_right(s: &mut InputState) { extend_selection(s, input_move_right); }\npub fn input_select_up(s: &mut InputState)    { extend_selection(s, input_move_up); }\npub fn input_select_down(s: &mut InputState)  { extend_selection(s, input_move_down); }\n\n/// Place cursor at (line, col) from a mouse click, optionally extending selection.\npub fn input_click(s: &mut InputState, li: usize, ci: usize, extend: bool) {\n    if extend {\n        if s.selection_anchor.is_none() {\n            s.selection_anchor = Some((s.cursor_line, s.cursor_col));\n        }\n        s.cursor_line = li;\n        s.cursor_col = ci;\n        let anchor = s.selection_anchor.unwrap();\n        let cursor = (li, ci);\n        if anchor == cursor {\n            s.selection = None;\n            s.selection_anchor = None;\n        } else {\n            let (start, end) = if anchor <= cursor { (anchor, cursor) } else { (cursor, anchor) };\n            s.selection = Some(crate::state::Selection {\n                start_line: start.0, start_col: start.1,\n                end_line: end.0, end_col: end.1,\n            });\n        }\n    } else {\n        s.cursor_line = li;\n        s.cursor_col = ci;\n        s.selection = None;\n        s.selection_anchor = None;\n    }\n}\n\npub fn input_select_all(s: &mut InputState) {"

> AGENT

`source "$HOME/.cargo/env" && cargo run`

Fixed:
1. **`>` inside** — rendered as a prefix span inside the border, not as a title on the border line
2. **Shift+Enter** inserts a newline. Also **Alt+Enter** as fallback (many terminals don't send Shift+Enter correctly)
3. **Shift+Arrow** — extends selection with an anchor. First Shift+Arrow sets the anchor at the current cursor, subsequent shifts extend. Regular arrow clears selection. Selected text shows white bg + black text
4. **Mouse click** — places cursor at click position (accounting for the `> ` prefix)
5. **Mouse drag** — extends selection from click point

Root causes fixed:
- **Option/Alt+Arrow** was being eaten by pin navigation before reaching the input handler. Now pin nav only fires when focus is NOT input
- **Sessions Up/Down** was eating arrow keys from the input. Now guarded by `!Focus::Input`
- **Shift+Enter** — keyboard enhancement enabled. Also **Ctrl+J** as guaranteed fallback (works in every terminal)

To navigate sessions: click the Sessions tab (focus switches to sidebar), then use arrows. Click anywhere in the input or type a char → focus returns to input automatically.

> AGENT

`source "$HOME/.cargo/env" && cargo run`

The double-jump was caused by `REPORT_ALL_KEYS_AS_ESCAPE_CODES` — it makes the terminal send both key-down and key-release events, so one keypress fired `extend_selection` twice, jumping 2 words. Now:
- Only `DISAMBIGUATE_ESCAPE_CODES` is active (needed for Shift+Enter)
- Key release events are explicitly filtered out
- Option/Alt+Arrow = 1 word per press
- Shift+Option+Arrow = selects 1 word per press

The bug: `input_move_left/right/up/down` clear `s.selection` but NOT `s.selection_anchor`. After clearing a selection with a plain arrow, the anchor stays set. Next Shift+Arrow then extends from the old stale anchor → huge selection.

Fix: clear `selection_anchor` everywhere `selection` is cleared:

> AGENT

`source "$HOME/.cargo/env" && cargo run`

The stale anchor was the bug. When you pressed a regular arrow to cancel a selection, `selection` was cleared but `selection_anchor` stayed set. Next Shift+Arrow then computed selection from the OLD anchor → huge jump.

Now every movement function calls `clear_selection()` which resets both `selection` AND `selection_anchor`. Shift+Arrow always selects exactly 1 character from wherever the cursor currently is.

> DEVELOPER

1. option + arrow should jump from word to word.... it doesnt work fix it
2. when whe use shift+ alt + left arrow, it selects word by word, but it starts selection not from the current character, but from the 1 char on the left... fix it

> AGENT

Issue 1: On macOS, many terminals send `Option+Left` as `Alt+b` and `Option+Right` as `Alt+f` (old Emacs/readline escape sequences), not as `Alt+Left`. Let me add those handlers AND debug what's actually being received.

Issue 2: When cursor is at position N and you press Shift+Alt+Left, anchor is set at N but selection is `[word_start, N)` — the char AT N (where your cursor block was) isn't included. Fix: set anchor at `N+1` so selection includes the current char.

  "old_string": "/// Set anchor if not set, move cursor, update selection.\nfn extend_selection(s: &mut InputState, move_fn: fn(&mut InputState)) {\n    if s.selection_anchor.is_none() {\n        s.selection_anchor = Some((s.cursor_line, s.cursor_col));\n    }\n    let anchor = s.selection_anchor;\n    move_fn(s);\n    s.selection_anchor = anchor;\n    // Update selection based on anchor vs cursor\n    if let Some((al, ac)) = s.selection_anchor {\n        let cursor = (s.cursor_line, s.cursor_col);\n        if (al, ac) == cursor {\n            s.selection = None;\n            s.selection_anchor = None;\n        } else {\n            let (start, end) = if (al, ac) <= cursor { ((al, ac), cursor) } else { (cursor, (al, ac)) };\n            s.selection = Some(crate::state::Selection {\n                start_line: start.0, start_col: start.1,\n                end_line: end.0, end_col: end.1,\n            });\n        }\n    }\n}",

> AGENT

`source "$HOME/.cargo/env" && cargo run`

The `cursor+1` anchor was the bug — on first Shift+Left it was selecting 2 chars (anchor=N+1, cursor moves to N-1 = range of 2). Each subsequent press added 1 more, making the count inconsistent, and after enough presses Shift+Right would be consumed shrinking the oversized selection rather than moving visibly.

Now back to `anchor = cursor`. Shift+Left/Right each select exactly 1 char per press. Shift+Alt+Left/Right select 1 word per press.

> DEVELOPER

shift + left doesnt work properly...it starts selecting from the bext left char

> AGENT

The selection rendering is the core issue. With anchor=cursor, Shift+Left highlights char N-1 (the new cursor position) instead of char N (the char the cursor was covering). 

The fix: change the selection rendering rule to:
- **Left selection** (cursor < anchor): highlight `(cursor, anchor]` — exclude cursor pos, include anchor  
- **Right selection** (cursor > anchor): highlight `[anchor, cursor)` — include anchor, exclude cursor

This way the char AT the anchor (original cursor position) is always highlighted in both directions:

> TOOL

tool_use Edit
id: toolu_01GnBfUNRUMQivMoa3wpkqwU
```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/4thwithme/Documents/repo/clui/rust/crates/app/src/ui/input.rs",
  "old_string": "fn in_selection(state: &InputState, li: usize, ci: usize) -> bool {\n    let Some(sel) = &state.selection else { return false };\n    let (sl, sc, el, ec) = if (sel.start_line, sel.start_col) < (sel.end_line, sel.end_col) {\n        (sel.start_line, sel.start_col, sel.end_line, sel.end_col)\n    } else {\n        (sel.end_line, sel.end_col, sel.start_line, sel.start_col)\n    };\n    if li < sl || li > el { false }\n    else if li == sl && li == el { ci >= sc && ci < ec }\n    else if li == sl { ci >= sc }\n    else if li == el { ci < ec }\n    else { true }\n}",
  "new_string": "fn in_selection(state: &InputState, li: usize, ci: usize) -> bool {\n    // Need an anchor to know the selection direction\n    let Some(anchor) = state.selection_anchor else { return false };\n    if state.selection.is_none() { return false; }\n    let cursor = (state.cursor_line, state.cursor_col);\n    if cursor == anchor { return false; }\n    let pos = (li, ci);\n    if cursor < anchor {\n        // Left-extending: highlight (cursor, anchor] — anchor char included, cursor char excluded\n        pos > cursor && pos <= anchor\n    } else {\n        // Right-extending: highlight [anchor, cursor) — anchor char included, cursor char excluded\n        pos >= anchor && pos < cursor\n    }\n}"
}

  "old_string": "/// Set anchor if not set, move cursor, update selection.\nfn extend_selection(s: &mut InputState, move_fn: fn(&mut InputState)) {\n    if s.selection_anchor.is_none() {\n        s.selection_anchor = Some((s.cursor_line, s.cursor_col));\n    }\n    let anchor = s.selection_anchor;\n    move_fn(s); // clears selection_anchor, so restore after\n    s.selection_anchor = anchor;\n    if let Some((al, ac)) = s.selection_anchor {\n        let cursor = (s.cursor_line, s.cursor_col);\n        let anchor_pt = (al, ac);\n        if anchor_pt == cursor {\n            s.selection = None;\n            s.selection_anchor = None;\n        } else {\n            let (start, end) = if anchor_pt <= cursor { (anchor_pt, cursor) } else { (cursor, anchor_pt) };\n            s.selection = Some(crate::state::Selection {\n                start_line: start.0, start_col: start.1,\n                end_line: end.0, end_col: end.1,\n            });\n        }\n    }\n}",
  "new_string": "/// Set anchor if not set, move cursor, update selection.\n/// Selection bounds are stored to match the visually highlighted region:\n/// - Right (anchor <= cursor): [anchor, cursor) — anchor char included, cursor char excluded\n/// - Left  (cursor < anchor):  [cursor+1, anchor+1) — current char included, cursor char excluded\nfn extend_selection(s: &mut InputState, move_fn: fn(&mut InputState)) {\n    if s.selection_anchor.is_none() {\n        s.selection_anchor = Some((s.cursor_line, s.cursor_col));\n    }\n    let anchor = s.selection_anchor;\n    move_fn(s); // clears selection_anchor, restore after\n    s.selection_anchor = anchor;\n    if let Some(anchor_pt) = s.selection_anchor {\n        let cursor = (s.cursor_line, s.cursor_col);\n        if anchor_pt == cursor {\n            s.selection = None;\n            s.selection_anchor = None;\n        } else if cursor < anchor_pt {\n            // Left-extending: visually highlight (cursor, anchor] = [cursor+1, anchor+1)\n            let start = advance_pos(&s.lines, cursor.0, cursor.1);\n            let end   = advance_pos(&s.lines, anchor_pt.0, anchor_pt.1);\n            s.selection = Some(crate::state::Selection {\n                start_line: start.0, start_col: start.1,\n                end_line:   end.0,   end_col:   end.1,\n            });\n        } else {\n            // Right-extending: visually highlight [anchor, cursor)\n            s.selection = Some(crate::state::Selection {\n                start_line: anchor_pt.0, start_col: anchor_pt.1,\n                end_line:   cursor.0,   end_col:   cursor.1,\n            });\n        }\n    }\n}"
}

> AGENT

`source "$HOME/.cargo/env" && cargo run`

What changed:
- **Shift+Left** from cursor at char N: highlights char N (the char the block is on), cursor moves left. Each press adds 1 more char to the left.
- **Shift+Right** from cursor at char N: highlights char N, cursor moves right. Same behavior.
- Both directions are consistent — the char AT the cursor is always the first char selected.
- Deletion (`Backspace` with selection) deletes exactly the highlighted chars.

> AGENT

`source "$HOME/.cargo/env" && cargo run`

Behavior now:

**Alt+Right / Shift+Alt+Right**: stops at END of current word (before the space)
- `hel|lo world` → `hello| world`

**Alt+Left / Shift+Alt+Left**: stops at START of current word; if already at start, jumps to start of previous word
- `hello wor|ld` → `hello |world`
- `hello |world` → `|hello world`
